'''﻿a''' — ''and/or'' <small>''[conjunction for nouns]''</small>


:'''ei mi tavla la alis a la kevin''' — ''I need to speak to Alice or Kevin (or to both of them).''

'''a'a''' — attention <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''a'acu'i''' — inattentiveness

'''a'anai''' — avoiding
:'''.a'a ko ca'o skicu''' — ''I'm listening, go on talking!''

'''a'e''' — alertness <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''a'enai''' — exhaustion

'''a'i''' — ''Oomph!'' (effort, endeavor) <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''a'u''' — ''Hmm... I wonder ...'' (interest) <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''ba'a''' — ''I expect'' <small>''[evidential]''</small>

'''ba'acu'i''' — ''I experience''

'''ba'anai''' — ''I remember''
:Comment: ???'''ba'a''' describes knowledge not yet know, '''ba'acu'i''' — knowledge being acquired at the moment of speking, '''ba'anai''' describes already acquired knowledge. The events marked with these interjections may happen at any time, thus '''ba'a''' might be related to past events, which you simply don't have information about yet..
:'''ba'a lo mi mamta ca zvati le zdani''' — ''I expect my mother to be at home now.''
:'''ba'a le mi pendo pu jinga''' — ''I expect my friend to have won.''
:'''ba'acu'i lo se klani be lo sovda cu lacri lo tcika lo nu lo jipci cu jai gau cfari''' — ''In my experience, the number of eggs depends on when a hen starts.''
:'''ba'anai do na nelci lo laldo prenu''' — ''As I remember, you don't like old people.''
:Related words: '''bavykri''', '''lifri''', '''morji'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI2</small></span>

:Comment: converts one word into a letter pronoun. From verbs: lujvo formed with '''zei''' are fine: '''xy''' '''zei''' '''kantu''' '''bu'''. From nouns: '''vy.''' '''bu''' (it denotes the letter w and thus isn't the same as '''vy.'''), '''zo a bu''', '''zoi ly.klama.ly. bu''', '''lo'u klam le'u bu'''. The following sequences are not grammatical: '''bu bu''', '''si bu''', '''sa bu''', '''su bu''', '''zei bu''', '''fa'o bu''', '''zo bu''', '''zoi bu''', '''lo'u bu'''.

'''ca''' — ''during ...'', ''simultaneousely with ...'' (in time). Adverb: ''meanwhile'', ''now'', ''currently'', expresses present tense <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''loi rirni pu zvati lo barja''' — ''The parents were in the bar, meanwhile the children were alone at home.''

'''ca'a''' — ''actually is or does...'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>

:'''ca'e do zutse va''' — ''You sit there!''

'''ca'o''' — progress of the event. ''be doing ...'' or ''being ...'' (progressive aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>

'''co''' — inverts the order of parts of compound verb

'''co'a''' — at the start of the event (inchoative aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''pu co'a ru'i carvi''' — ''It started raining.''

:'''co'a pelxu        ''' — ''It's turning yellow.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZAhO</small></span>

'''co'i''' — aspect treating the whole event without internal structure (perfective aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>

'''co'inai''' — aspect treating the whole event as having internal structure (imperfective aspect)
:'''mi pu co'inai citka lo mango ca lo nu ra co'i nerkla        ''' — ''I was eating a mango when she entered.       .''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZAhO</small></span>

'''co'o''' — ''Goodbye! Bye!'' <small>''[vocative]''</small>

'''co'oi''' — ''Ciao!'' (''hello!'' or ''goodbye!'' depending on context) <small>''[vocative]''</small>

'''co'u''' — quitting, stopping even if before the expected end (cessative aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>

'''derxi''' — x1 (entity) is a heap or stack of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo derxi''' — heap
:'''mi pu cupra lo derxi be lo mudri''' — ''I chopped a pile of wood.''
:Related words: '''gunma''', '''cmana'''

'''desku''' — x1 (entity) is shakes or vibrates from force x2 (event)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo desku''' — something vibrating
:'''ra pu desku lo ka terpa''' — ''She was shaking with fear.''
:Related words: '''slilu''', '''janbe'''

'''di'''
:Comment: there exists something or someone.
:'''i ku'i la'anai su'o da cizra ro de ro di''' — ''But it is unlikely that something is strange to everyone in every way.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA1 (DA)</small></span>

'''di'a''' — resuming (resumptive aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''mi na ba di'a zgipli fi lo pipno''' — ''I won't play the piano again.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZAhO</small></span>

'''di'ai''' — expression of well-wish <small>''[vocative]''</small>

'''di'ainai''' — expression of curse
:Comment: used to express well-wishes/curses.
:'''pluka nicte di'ai''' — ''Good night!''
:'''di'ai do''' — ''Good luck to you.''
:'''do i ko na raktu mi di'ainai do''' — ''Don't disturb me, damn you!''
:Related words: '''dimna''', '''dapma''', '''ki'e''', '''doi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: COI</small></span>

'''di'e''' — the next utterance <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''di'e na drani''' — ''The following sentence isn't correct.''
:'''la djon cu cmene mi''' — ''Someone called John is my name.''
:'''lu zo djon cmene mi li'u drani ku'i''' — ''John is my name is correct, though.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA2</small></span>

'''di'i''' — ''regularly'' (iterative aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>

'''di'inai''' — ''irregularly''
:'''mi di'i cadzu bu'u lo panka''' — ''I regularly walk in the park.''
:'''pa cukta di'i se tcidu mi''' — ''I read the same book again and again.''
:'''mi di'inai citka lo kokso''' — ''I eat coconuts here and there.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: TAhE</small></span>

'''di'u''' — the last utterance <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''ma xamgu traji tadji lo nu tadni la lojban''' — ''What is the best method of learning Lojban?''
:'''di'u xamgu se retsku''' — ''That is a good question.''
:'''la alis ze'a lo djedi be li za'u re na zvati ''' — ''Alice isn't present for more than two days.''
:'''la'e di'u cizra''' — ''That is strange.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA2</small></span>

'''dicra''' — x1 (entity) interrupts or disrupts x2 (entity) due to quality x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo sance pu dicra lo nu mi sipna vau lo ka cladu''' — ''The sound woke me up since it was loud.''
:Related words: '''zunti''', '''fanza''', '''raktu''', '''denpa'''

'''diklo''' — x1 (entity) is confined to location x2 (entity) within range x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo diklo''' — local
:'''lo ca carvi cu diklo lo stuna lo dei tcadu''' — ''Within the borders of this city the rain is in the south.''
:Related words: '''di'o''', '''jibni''', '''zvati''', '''cpana''', '''nenri''', '''lamji''', '''stuzi''', '''tcila'''

'''dikni''' — x1 (entity) is regular or periodic in x2 (property of x1) with interval x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dikni''' — regular
:'''mi dikni lo ka lumci lo mi kumfa vau lo jeftu''' — ''I am regular in cleaning my room every week.''
:Related words: '''slilu''', '''rilti''', '''xutla''', '''manfo''', '''boxna'''

'''dilcu''' — x1 (number) is a quotient of x2 (number) divided by x3 (number) , leaving remainder x4 (number)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dilcu''' — quotient, '''lo se dilcu''' — dividend of a quotient, '''lo te dilcu''' — divisor of a quotient, '''lo ve dilcu''' — remainder of a quotient
:'''li re dilcu li paci li mu li ci''' — ''2 is the quotient of 13 divided by 5 with the remainder 3.''
:Related words: '''frinu''', '''fendi''', '''katna''', '''parbi''', '''mekso'''

'''dilnu''' — x1 (entity) is a cloud of material x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dilnu''' — cloud
:'''le cmana cu cupra lo dilnu be lo danmo''' — ''The mountain produces clouds of smoke.''
:Related words: '''carvi''', '''tcima'''

'''dimna''' — x1 (property of x2) is a fate or destiny of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dimna''' — destiny
:'''lo ka xabju ti cu dimna mi''' — ''To live here is my fate.''
:Related words: '''dapma'''

'''dinju''' — x1 (entity) is a building for purpose x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dinju''' — building
:'''ti dinju lo nu lumci''' — ''This is a bathhouse.''
:Related words: '''ginka''', '''zdani''', '''zarci'''

'''dinko''' — x1 (entity) is a nail or tack for purpose x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dinko''' — nail (tack)
:'''mi pu lasna lo pixra lo bitmu lo dinko sepi'o lo mruli''' — ''I nailed the picture to the wall using a hammer.''
:'''ti dinko lo ka lasna lo cutci lo xirma ce'u''' — ''This is a nail for fastening horseshoes.''
:Related words: '''pijne''', '''lasna'''

'''dirba''' — x1 (entity, property of x2) is dear or precious to x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dirba''' — precious
:'''do pu zvati ma doi dirba''' — ''Where have you been, dear?''
:'''lo nu jmive cu dirba ro da''' — ''Life is dear to everybody.''
:Related words: '''tcika''', '''kargu''', '''vamji''', '''vajni''', '''pleji''', '''jadni''', '''jemna'''

'''dirce''' — x1 (entity) radiates or emits x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dirce''' — emitter, '''lo se dirce''' — radiation
:'''le jinto cu dirce lo djacu''' — ''The spring of fluid emits water.''
:Related words: '''gusni'''

'''dirgo''' — x1 (entity) is a drop of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dirgo''' — drop
:'''sa'u ti dirgo lo djacu''' — ''It's just a drop of water.''
:Related words: '''daplu''', '''bidju'''

'''ditcu''' — x1 (event) is the time-duration/period of x2 (event)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo ditcu''' — period
:'''ma ditcu lo nu do limna lo rirxe''' — ''How long have you been swimming in the river?''
:Related words: '''cedra''', '''ranji''', '''tcika''', '''renvi''', '''temci''', '''canlu''', '''kuspe''', '''krafamtei'''

'''dizlo''' — x1 (entity) is low compared to x2 (entity) (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dizlo''' — low
:'''i lo gerku cu dizlo lo mlatu poi cpare lo tricu''' — ''The dog stands low compared to the cat climbing the tree.''
:'''mi mo'u farlu lo dizlo be lo bitmu''' — ''I fell down to the foot of the fence.''
:Related words: '''cnita''', '''galtu''', '''gapru''', '''farna''', '''loldi'''

'''djacu''' — x1 (entity) is some water<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo djacu''' — water
:'''le nakni pu pinxe lo djacu lo pa kabri''' — ''He drank some water from the cup.''
:Related words: '''lalxu''', '''rirxe''', '''xamsi''', '''limna''', '''litki''', '''lumci''', '''bumru''', '''jinto'''

'''djedi''' — x1 (event) is x2 (number) full days long<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo djedi''' — full day, '''lo se djedi''' — number of full days
:'''mi volve bazi lo djedi be li pano''' — ''I will return in 10 days.''
:Related words: '''donri''', '''detri''', '''jeftu''', '''masti''', '''nanca''', '''nicte''', '''tcika'''

'''djica''' — x1 (entity) desires or wants x2 (event, property of x1) for purpose x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>, '''lo se djica''' — something desired
:'''mi djica lo nu cusku lo xajmi vau lo nu do cisma''' — ''I want tell something funny to make you smile.''
:'''mi djica tu'a lo so'i cukta lo ka tcidu''' — ''I want many books to read.''
:Related words: '''taske''', '''xagji''', '''mukti''', '''nitcu''', '''nelci''', '''pacna''', '''prami''', '''rigni''', '''trina''', '''xebni''', '''xlura'''

'''djuno''' — x1 (entity) knows fact x2 (proposition) about x3 (entity) on grounds x4 (proposition)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: For 'know/familiar with' use '''se''' '''slabu''', '''na'e''' '''cnino''', '''na'e''' '''fange''', '''lo se djuno''' — known fact, '''lo ve djuno''' — grounds of knowledge
:'''mi djuno lo du'u mi zasti vau fo lo du'u mi pensi''' — ''I know that I exist since I think.''
:'''mi djuno so'i da la lojban''' — ''I know a lot about Lojban.''
:Related words: '''se''' '''slabu''', '''na'e''' '''cnino''', '''na'e''' '''fange''', '''du'o''', '''krici''', '''jinvi''', '''cilre''', '''certu''', '''facki''', '''jijnu''', '''jimpe''', '''senpi''', '''smadi''', '''kakne''', '''birti''', '''mipri''', '''morji''', '''saske''', '''viska''',

'''do''' — ''you'' (the listener) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''coi ro do''' — ''Hello, everyone!''
:'''xu do djica lo nu mi sidju do''' — ''Do you want me to help you?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''do'a''' — ''generously, broadly construed'' <small>''[discursive]''</small>

'''do'anai''' — ''at least'' (parsimoniously)
:Comment: https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sensu_stricto ?.
:'''do'a mi do ka'e ctuca lo se jmina''' — ''I could teach you some additional things.''
:'''do'a nai do no da zekri lebna''' — ''At least you didn't stel anything.''
:'''a'o mi te dunda lo kargu karce a do'a nai lo karce poi na spofu''' — ''Hopefully, I'll be given an expensive car or at least one that isn't broken.''
:Related words: '''dunda'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3</small></span>

'''do'e''' — preposition with the meaning unspecified or known from context <small>''[preposition from {co'e}]''</small>


:Comment: also used in speech when it's hard to find an appropriate preposition on the fly.
:'''ti karda do'e lo valsi''' — ''It's a card with a word.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''do'i''' — an utterance unspecified or known from context <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''do'i cu me lo jufra pe lo se cukta poi mi pu tcidu''' — ''That sentence is from a book that I had read.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA2</small></span>

'''do'o''' — ''you'' (the listener, might include other persons not in the dialog) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''mi'a pu casnu lo nu litru - do'o pu cuxna ma''' — ''We discussed travelling. - What did you choose?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''do'u'''
:starts with: COI, DOI<span style='float:right'><small>class: DOhU</small></span>

'''doi''' — general vocative, identifies intended listener. <small>''[vocative]''</small>


:'''doi nobli do co'u morji fi lo do ckiku''' — ''Oh, sir! You forgot your keys.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: DOI</small></span>

'''donri''' — x1 (entity) is daytime of day x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo donri''' — daytime
:'''ca lo donri be lo prulamdei ra pu stali lo zdani''' — ''Yesterday in the daytime he stayed at home.''
:Related words: '''nicte''', '''djedi''', '''tcika'''

'''draci''' — x1 (entity) is a drama or play about x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo draci''' — play (drama), '''lo se draci''' — plot of a drama
:'''lo pendo be mi cu finti lo draci be lo nabmi pe lo te seksi''' — ''My friend is the author of a drama about the problem of sexes.''
:Related words: '''finti''', '''cukta''', '''lisri''', '''cfika'''

'''drani''' — x1 (entity) is correct in x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo drani''' — correct
:'''do drani lo ka pilno makau poi valsi''' — ''You are correct in what words you use.''
:Related words: '''srera''', '''mapti'''

'''drata''' — x1 (entity) is not the same as x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo drata''' — different
:'''CC''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''mintu''', '''frica''', '''dunli'''

'''drudi''' — x1 (entity) is a roof or lid of structure x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: '''lo''' '''drudi''' is (designed to be) over/above something and shelters it from other things above '''lo''' '''drudi''', '''lo''' '''mapku'''
:'''lo drudi''' — lid, '''lo se drudi''' — something with a lid
:'''lo drudi be lo dinju cu ei se cikre''' — ''The roof of the building needs fixing.''
:Related words: '''bitmu''', '''stedu''', '''galtu''', '''gapru''', '''loldi''', '''marbi''', '''gacri''', '''mapku'''

'''du''' — ''x1, x2, x3 ... are the same thing''. Corresponds to the operator '=' in math <small>''[verb]''</small>


:Comment: can have any number of places.
:'''li pa su'i pa du li re li pano fe'i mu''' — ''1 + 1 = 2 = 10 / 5.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: GOhA</small></span>

'''du'e''' — too many <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:Comment: subjective estimate.
:'''le vacri ca du'eva'e glare''' — ''It's too hot.''
:'''du'e prenu cu zvati le laji''' — ''There are too many people in the street.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA4</small></span>

'''du'i''' — ''equally'', ''as much as ...'' <small>''[preposition from {dunli}]''</small>


:Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo se dunli''', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo dunli''' — ''equal to', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te zmadu''' — the comparison.
:'''mi'a du'i casnu lo mintu''' — ''We equally discussed the same.''
:'''xu do cando du'i mi''' — ''Are you as busy as I am?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''du'u''' — clause > verb <small>''[clause prefix]''</small>


:Comment: x1 is the clause (that follows) expressed in sentence x2 (text).
:'''mi djuno lo du'u do na fuzme''' — ''I know that you are not responsible.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: NU</small></span>

'''dugri''' — x1 (number) is the logarithm of x2 (number) to base x3 (number)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dugri''' — logarithm, '''lo te dugri''' — base of a logarithm
:'''li 3 dugri li 1000 li 10''' — ''3 is the logarithm of 1000 to base 10.''
:Related words: '''tenfa'''

'''dukti''' — x1 (entity) is opposite or contrary to x2 (entity) in x3 (property of x1 and x2 with '''kau''')<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dukti''' — opposite
:'''la alis la kevin pu dukti lo ka catlu makau''' — ''Alice and Kevin looked in the opposite directions.''
:Related words: '''ranxi''', '''ragve''', '''fatne'''

'''dunda''' — x1 (entity) gives or donates x2 (entity, property of x1) to x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dunda''' — giver, '''lo se dunda''' — gift, '''lo te dunda''' — receiver of a gift
:'''mi pu dunda lo plise do''' — ''I gave you an apple.''
:Related words: '''benji''', '''muvdu''', '''canja''', '''pleji''', '''vecnu''', '''friti''', '''sfasa''', '''dapma''', '''cnemu''', '''prali'''

'''dunja''' — x1 (entity) freezes<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''ra na ru'e dunja''' — ''He almost froze.''
:Related words: '''febvi''', '''lunsa''', '''runme''', '''sligu'''

'''dunku''' — x1 (entity) is distressed or anguished by x2 (event)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dunku''' — distressed, '''lo se dunku''' — distressing event
:'''mi pu dunku lo ka nonseka''' — ''I was distressed at beging alone.''
:'''xu do dunku lo nu lo do mensi cu bilma''' — ''Are you distressed at your sister being ill?''
:Related words: '''fengu''', '''surla'''

'''dunli''' — x1 (entity) is equal to x2 (any type) in x3 (property of x1 and x2 with '''kau''')<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dunli''' — equal
:'''CC''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''du'i''', '''satci''', '''frica''', '''simsa''', '''mintu'''

'''dunra''' — x1 (entity) is winter of year x2 (entity) at location x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dunra''' — winter
:'''ca lo dunra be lo renonomu moi bei la australias mi pu zvati ti''' — ''During Australian winter of year 2005 I was here.''
:Related words: '''citsi''', '''crisa''', '''critu''', '''vensa'''

'''dy''' — letter 'D' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>

<span style='float:right'><small>class: BY2</small></span>

'''dzena''' — x1 (entity) is an elder or ancestor of x2 (entity) by bond x3 (property of x1 + x2)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo dzena''' — ancestor, '''lo se dzena''' — descendant
:'''do dzena mi lo ka ce'u ce'u lidne lo ka jbena ca makau''' — ''You are my ancestor since you were born before me.''

'''dzipo''' — x1 (entity) is Antarctican in x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''au mi vitka lo dzipo tumla''' — ''I want to visit the Antarctica.''
:Related words: '''ketco''', '''friko''', '''sralo''', '''terdi'''

'''e''' — ''and'' <small>''[conjunction for nouns]''</small>


:'''mi e do pu casnu lo za'u bangu''' — ''I discussed languages, and you discussed languages (may be not with each other, may be in different discussions).''
:Related words: '''ce''', '''je''', '''a''', '''e''', '''ji''', '''o''', '''u'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: A</small></span>

'''e'a''' — ''you may, I allow'' <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''e'anai''' — prohibiting
:'''e'a do klama lo nenri''' — ''You may come in.''

:'''e'anai crepu lo flora''' — ''You may not pick the flowers.''

'''e'e''' — instigation, provokation <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''e'enai''' — discouragement, demoralization
:'''e'e do jarco lo ka vlipa''' — ''Show your strength, go for it!''
:'''e'e mi kuspe do''' — ''I'll reach you.''
:'''e'enai mi claxu lo se ditcu''' — ''Sorry, I lack time.''

'''e'i''' — command, instruction, imposing obligation (imperative interjection)
:'''e'i mi cliva''' — ''I have to leave.''
:'''do sanga e'i''' — ''Sing!''

'''e'o''' — ''please'' (request) <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''e'onai''' — offer, grant
:'''e'o mi zgana''' — ''Let me see.''
:'''e'o do dunda le jisra mi''' — ''Will you pass the huice, please?''
:'''e'onai ko lebna lo titla''' — ''Here, take some candies.''
:Related words: '''cpedu''', '''pikci'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI1</small></span>

:'''e'unai do stapa lo crepu''' — ''You'd better not step onto the bridge.''
:Related words: '''stidi''', '''kajde'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI1</small></span>

'''ebu''' — letter 'E' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>



'''ei''' — ''I should ..., one should ...'' (obligation) <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''einai''' — freedom, how things need not be
:'''ei do ca sipna''' — ''You should be sleeping now.''
:'''ei do djuno''' — ''You ought to know.''
:'''einai do mipri lo nei''' — ''You needn't hide yourself.''
:Related words: '''bilga''', '''zifre'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI1</small></span>

'''enge''' — x1 (entity) is an architect/designer/engineer of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo enge''' — designer
:'''lo mi patfu pu enge lo vi dinju''' — ''My father was an architect of this building.''

'''entuzi''' — x1 (entity) is enthusiastic, excited about x2 (event, property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

:'''lo entuzi''' — enthusiastic

:'''lo esporte''' — sports, '''lo se esporte''' — sportsperson, sportsman, sportswoman

'''fa''' — prefix for the 1st noun of the current clause <small>''[case tag]''</small>


:'''fe zo coi cusku fa mi''' — ''Hello, said I.''
:'''fe ma fa mi zukte ei''' — ''What shoulg I do?''
:'''sarcu fa lo nu do zvati''' — ''It's required that you are present.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: FA</small></span>

'''fa'a''' — ''directly towards ...'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''ko catlu fa'a le canko''' — ''Look in the direction of the window.''
:'''xu le cipni ca'o vofli fa'a lo solri''' — ''Is the bird flying towards the Sun?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: FAhA4</small></span>

'''fa'u''' — ''and respectively ...'' (forms unmixed set) <small>''[conjunction]''</small>


:'''zmadu fa'u mleca fi lo ka sampu fa'u lo ka drani
''' — ''It's more easy and less correct, respectively.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: JOI</small></span>

'''facki''' — x1 (entity) discovers fact x2 (proposition) about x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: For searching for objects and finding them use '''mitysisku''' and '''tolcri'''
:'''lo facki''' — discoverer, '''lo se facki''' — a discovery
:'''mi facki lo jitfa lo pu se cusku be la alis''' — ''I discovered that what Alice said is false.''
:'''mi facki lo du'u le tcadu cu jibni''' — ''I found that the city is near.''
:'''mi pu facki lo du'u lo lisri cu xajmi''' — ''I found the story funny.''

'''fadni''' — x1 (entity) is ordinary in x2 (property of x1) among x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: wrong usage
:'''lo fadni''' — typical, ordinary

'''la'a''' — ''probably'' <small>''[discursive]''</small>

'''la'acu'i''' — ''possibly, may be''

'''la'anai''' — ''improbably''
:'''la'a ti traji lo ka misno''' — ''Probably, this is the most popular one.''
:'''la'aru'e ve ciksi''' — ''Probably, it's an expanation.''
:'''la'acu'i le nakni cu zukte seva'u le fetsi''' — ''May be, he is doing it for her.''
:'''la'anai la kevin ka'e jai gau birti fai la alis''' — ''It's improbable that Kevin can convince Alice.''
:Related words: '''lakne'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3</small></span>

'''la'e''' — ''what can be referred to by ...'' (noun follows)


:Comment: '''la'e''' [noun]' is the same as ''''lo''' '''se''' '''sinxa''' '''be''' [noun]'.
:ends with: lu'u
:'''do ce mi casnu da''' — ''The was something you and I discussed.''
:'''la'edi'u pu cacra li ji'i pa''' — ''And that lasted for approximately an hour.''
:'''la'e zo alis cu cinri cukta''' — ''Alice is an interesting book.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LAhE</small></span>

'''la'o''' — foreign text > noun that is a name


:Comment: quotes a text that can be not Lojbanic. The quotation is to be wrapped with pauses from both sides and with an additional Lojbanic word around them from both sides. Usually the separating words is the name of the first letter of the language of the quotation.
:'''la'o gy. The wild bears gy. jai cinri filme''' — ''The wild bears is an interesting movie.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZOI</small></span>

'''la'oi''' — foreign word > noun that is a name


:Comment: '''la'oi''' and one single word after it make a name. The word after '''la'oi''': might be from any language and written in any script, it is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides, it can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written. For names  with pauses inside use '''la'o'''.
:'''xu do se zdani la'oi Virginia''' — ''Do you live in Virginia?''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZOhOI</small></span>

'''lakne''' — x1 (event) is probable, likely<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lakne''' — probable
:'''lakne fa lo nu ba carvi''' — ''I will probably rain.''
:Related words: '''cumki''', '''jinzi''', '''kampu''', '''tcaci''', '''cunso''', '''cafne''', '''fadni''', '''cnano'''

'''lakse''' — x1 (entity) is some wax<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lakse''' — wax
:'''lo bifce cu cupra lo lakse''' — ''Bees produce wax.''
:Related words: '''bifce''', '''ranti''', '''bidju'''

'''laldo''' — x1 (entity) is old/aged in that it has x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo laldo''' — old, aged
:'''lo vi kosta cu laldo lo ka ze'a makau se dasni''' — ''This jacket is old in how long it has been worn.''
:Related words: '''citno''', '''slabu'''

'''lalxu''' — x1 (entity) is a lake or pool at site x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lalxu''' — lake, '''lo se lalxu''' — place with a lake
:'''ai mi vitke lo lalxu be le panku''' — ''I'm going to visit a lake in the park.''
:Related words: '''daplu''', '''djacu''', '''rirxe''', '''xamsi''', '''zbani'''

'''lamji''' — x1 (entity) is adjacent, next to x2 (entity) in x3 (property of x1 and x2) in direction x4 (property of x1 and x2, has two places)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lamji''' — adjacent
:'''lo zdani be la alis cu lamji lo ckule lo ka stuzi vau lo ka ce'u ce'u stici vo'a''' — ''Alice's home is adjacent to the school in where it is located and it is to the east of the school.''
:Related words: '''zvati''', '''cpana''', '''jibni''', '''diklo''', '''stuzi''', '''bartu''', '''jbini'''

'''lanbi''' — x1 (entity) is a quantity of protein<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lanbi''' — protein
:'''lo'e nanba cu vasru lo so'i lanbi''' — ''Bread contains a lot of protein.''
:Related words: '''ladru''', '''sovda'''

'''lanci''' — x1 (entity) is a flag or banner symbolizing x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lanci''' — flag, banner
:'''ti lanci la lojban''' — ''This is the flag of Lojban.''
:Related words: '''gugde''', '''jecta'''

'''lanka''' — x1 (entity) is a basket containing x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lanka''' — basket, '''lo se lanka''' — contents of a basket
:'''ko jgari lo lanka be lo fragari''' — ''Take a basket with strawberries.''
:Related words: '''vasru''', '''baktu'''

'''lanli''' — x1 (entity) analyzes x2 (entity) by method x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lanli''' — analyst, '''lo se lanli''' — something analysed, '''lo te lanli''' — method of analysis
:'''lo mikce cu lanli lo bilma lo ka tirna lo fepri''' — ''The doctor examines the patient by listening to the lungs.''
:Related words: '''cipra''', '''catlu''', '''zgana''', '''jarco''', '''pensi''', '''piksku'''

'''lanme''' — x1 (entity) is a sheep of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lanme''' — sheep
:'''lo vi cirla cu se zbasu fi lo ladru be lo lanme''' — ''This cheese is made from sheep's milk.''
:Related words: '''kanba''', '''sunla'''

'''lante''' — x1 (entity) is a can for x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lante''' — can, pre-sealed container, '''lo se lante''' — something canned
:'''ti lante lo festi''' — ''It's a can for waste.''
:Related words: '''botpi''', '''baktu''', '''tinci'''

'''lanxe''' — x1 (plural of entity) is in balance under forces x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: '''fapro''' for balancing/opposing forces
:'''lo lanxe''' — balanced
:'''lo ni mi gunka ce lo ni mi surla cu lanxe lo se zukte be mi''' — ''I keep my work and my leisure time in balance.''
:Related words: '''midju''', '''nutli''', '''fapro''', '''nutli'''

'''lanzu''' — x1 (entity) is a family including x2 (entity) by bond x3 (relation between members of x2, contains two places for '''ce'u''')<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lanzu''' — family, '''lo se lanzu''' — family member
:'''ti lanzu lo citno lo ka ce'u ce'u prami''' — ''This is a family of young people bound by a mutual love.''
:Related words: '''natmi''', '''cmima''', '''girzu''', '''jutsi''', '''klesi'''

'''larcu''' — x1 (property of nonce place) is an art, creative application of skill x2 (proposition)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo larcu''' — art, '''lo se larcu''' — craft
:'''za'a do certu lo larcu be lo ka finti lo melbi se sanga''' — ''I can see, you are an expert in creating beautiful songs.''
:'''lo ka prami cu larcu''' — ''Love is an art.''
:Related words: '''finti''', '''zbasu''', '''stati'''

'''lasna''' — x1 (entity) fastens or binds x2 (entity) to x3 (entity) with x4 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lasna''' — fastener, '''lo se lasna''' — fastened
:'''le prenu pu lasna la kevin lo kamju lo skori''' — ''The person tied Kevin to a pillar with a rope.''
:Related words: '''jorne''', '''fenso''', '''jgena''', '''batke''', '''dinko''', '''kansa'''

'''lastu''' — x1 (entity) is a quantity of brass<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lastu''' — brass
:'''lo lastu cu mixre lo tunka joi lo zinki''' — ''Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.''
:Related words: '''jinme''', '''ransu''', '''tunka'''

'''latna''' — x1 (entity) is a lotus of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo latna''' — lotus
:'''lo latna co'a me lo flora poi se panci lo pluka''' — ''The lotus turns into a flower with a pleasant scent.''
:Related words: '''budjo''', '''censa''', '''lijda''', '''spati'''

'''lazni''' — x1 (entity) is lazy concerning action x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lazni''' — lazy, '''lo se lazni''' — action lazily avoided
:'''mi lazni lo ka catlu lo matra''' — ''I am lazy to look at the engine.''
:Related words: '''nejni''', '''vreta''', '''gunka'''

'''le''' — verb > noun previously mentioned


:Comment: ''the'', creates pronoun like ''she'', ''he'' from noun. '''le fetsi''' is 'she', '''le nakni''' is 'he', '''le''' '''za'umei''' is 'they'.
:'''mi pu viska lo fetsi''' — ''I saw a female.''
:'''le fetsi cu melbi''' — ''She is pretty.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LE</small></span>

'''le'ai'''
:starts with: lo'ai<span style='float:right'><small>class: LEhAI</small></span>

'''le'e''' — verb > noun denoting a typical thing previously mentioned


:Comment: ''the typical one that does or is ...'' (previously defined).
:'''lo'e cipni cu kakne lo ka vofli i mi tadni le'e cipni''' — ''Typical birds can fly. And I study such birds.''
:Related words: '''le''', '''lo''', '''lo'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LE</small></span>

'''le'o''' — ''Grr!'' (aggression) <small>''[interjection modifier]''</small>

'''le'ocu'i''' — expressing passive (non-agressive) emotion

'''le'onai''' — expressing defensive emotion
:'''le'o ro ko tinbe fi mi''' — ''Everybody follow my orders!''
:'''le'ocu'i sa'u mi pu retsku zo'ei lo ni do kanro''' — ''Hey, I just asked you about your health.''
:'''le'onai mi jimpe lo du'u ei mi zutse ti''' — ''Okay, okay, I understand that I have to sit here.''
:Related words: '''gunta''', '''bandu'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI5</small></span>

'''le'u'''
:starts with: LOhU<span style='float:right'><small>class: LEhU</small></span>

'''lebna''' — x1 (entity) takes or seizes x2 (entity, property of x3) from x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: in '''cpacu''' volition or previous possession is not necessarily implied, '''vimcu''' is for alienation where x1 need not gain possession, '''lo se lebna''' — something taken
:'''le za'umei pu lebna fi mi fe lo ka se krali lo ka ponse le karce''' — ''They took my rights on owning the car.''
:'''mi pu lebna lo titla le tanxe ca lo nu lo drata na jundi''' — ''I took a candie from the box when other weren't attentive.''
:Related words: '''punji''', '''cpacu''', '''vimcu''', '''canci''', '''cliva'''

'''lei''' — verb > noun denoting a mass previously mentioned


:Comment: ''the ...'', ''the mass of those that are ...'' (previously mentioned).
:'''mi pu zgana loi prenu je ba co'a sanli ibabo mi pu muvdu fa'a lei prenu''' — ''I noticed a crowd and stood up. After that I moved into the direction of the crowd.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LE</small></span>

'''lektoni''' — x1 is an electron<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: ???remove?
:'''lo lektoni''' — electron
:'''lo lektoni cu kantu''' — ''Electron is an elementary particle.''
:Related words: '''letri'''

'''lenjo''' — x1 (entity) is a lens focusing rays x2 (entity) to the focus x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: lenjo2 is usually light. Light from the original object comes through x1 in the form of x2 onto x3
:'''lo lenjo''' — lens, '''lo se lenjo''' — rays focused by a lens, '''lo te lenjo''' — focus of a lens
:'''ti lenjo lo gusni lo darno''' — ''This lens focusing light has a long focal length.''
:'''mi co'a dasni loi lenjo tezu'e lo ka sfubu''' — ''I put on goggles in order to dive.''
:'''ko bevri fi mi fe loi mi lenjo''' — ''Bring me my glasses.''
:Related words: '''kacma''', '''minra'''

'''lenku''' — x1 (entity) is cold<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lenku''' — cold
:'''lo vacri ca'o lenku''' — ''It's getting cold.''
:Related words: '''glare''', '''bisli'''

'''lerci''' — x1 (entity) is late by standard x2 (proposition)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lerci''' — late event
:'''lo nu mi volve lo zdani cu lerci lo se jinvi be lo mamta be mi''' — ''According to my mother I returned home late.''
:Related words: '''clira'''

'''lerfu''' — x1 (entity) is a letter, symbol in word or alphabet x2 (entity, text) representing x3 (entity, sound)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lerfu''' — letter, alphabetic symbol
:'''zoi ry.д.ry. lerfu lo rusko zo d''' — ''д is a letter of Russian alphabet representing sound '''d'''.''
:Related words: '''mifra''', '''namcu''', '''sinxa''', '''pandi'''

'''letri''' — x1 (entity) is electric in x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo letri''' — electric
:'''lo dilnu cu letri lo ka cupra lo lindi''' — ''The cloud are electric in that they produce lightnings.''
:Related words: '''magneti''', '''trina''', '''xlura'''

'''li''' — number > value


:Comment: value of the following number or a math expression.
:'''li vo cu sumji li re li re''' — ''4 is the sum of 2 and 2.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LI</small></span>

'''li'a''' — ''clearly, of course'' <small>''[discursive]''</small>

'''li'anai''' — obscurely
:'''li'a do xanka''' — ''You are clearly worried.''
:'''li'a no da poi te ckini be la alis bei la kevin pu na drani''' — ''Clearly, nothing in their relations was amiss.''
:'''li'a mi pu noroi vitke lo dzipo tumla''' — ''Of course, I have never been to Antarctica.''
:'''li'anai lo tcima cu lacri le solri''' — ''Weather depends on the sun, I see, but it's complicated.''
:Related words: '''klina'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3</small></span>

'''li'i''' — clause > verb <small>''[clause prefix]''</small>


:Comment: x1 (property of x2) is x2's experience described in the clause that follows. The first omitted place of the clause is assumed to be the second place of the '''li'i''' clause..
:'''lo pluka ko li'i se senva''' — ''Have a pleasant dream (sweat dreams!) Bon appetite!''
:'''lo pluka ko li'i se citka i ma do li'i salci''' — ''How did you like the party?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: NU</small></span>

'''li'o''' — ''and so on'' (omitted text) <small>''[discursive]''</small>


:'''lo pavdei cu pa moi djedi i lo reldei cu re moi djedi i li'o''' — ''Monday is the first day, Tuesday is the second day, and so on.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3a</small></span>

'''li'u'''
:Comment: seldom elidable except at end of text.
:starts with: LU<span style='float:right'><small>class: LIhU</small></span>

'''lianpi''' — x1 is a cheek of x2<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lianpi''' — cheek
:'''ra pu se lianpi lo plana''' — ''She had chubby cheeks.''
:Related words: '''flira''', '''mlana'''

'''lianzi''' — x1 (entity) is a length of chain with links or rings x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lianzi''' — chain, '''lo se lianzi''' — link of a chain, ring of a chain
:'''ti lianzi lo barda je rijno''' — ''This is a chain with big silver rings.''
:Related words: '''cukla''', '''gunma''', '''lasna'''

'''lidne''' — x1 (entity) precedes x2 (same type as x1) in x3 (property of x1 and x2)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: '''purci''' is for time sequence
:'''lo mlatu ba lidne lo gerku lo ka se casnu ca makau''' — ''Cats will be discussed before dogs.''
:Related words: '''li'e''', '''balvi''', '''ralju''', '''rebla''', '''purci''', '''jersi''', '''porsi''', '''jatna''', '''farna'''

'''lifri''' — x1 (entity) experiences x2 (event)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lifri''' — experiencer, patient (experiencer), '''lo se lifri''' — experienced event

:'''do ba lifri lo nabmi''' — ''You'll get into trouble.''
:'''mi pu lifri lo ka ganse lo cizra''' — ''I underwent strange sensation.''

'''lijda''' — x1 (entity) is a religion of believers x2 (entity) sharing beliefs x3 (proposition)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lijda''' — religion, '''lo se lijda''' — religious believer, '''lo te lijda''' — religious belief

:'''la animism cu lijda lo remna poi se zdani lo vi tumla lo du'u ro dacti cu vasru lo pruxi''' — ''Animism is a religion of people living on this land that asserts that every object contains a spirit.''
:'''do se lijda ma''' — ''What is your religion?''

:'''lo limna''' — swimmer
:'''e'anai do limna lo xamsi''' — ''Don't swim in the sea!''
:Related words: '''djacu''', '''fulta''', '''klama''', '''litru'''

'''lindi''' — x1 (entity) is a lightning striking at x2 (entity) from x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lindi''' — lightning
:'''sa'u tu pe pu cu lindi lo darno lo dilnu''' — ''That was just a lightning that stroke far way from here from a cloud.''
:Related words: '''letri'''

'''linji''' — x1 (entity) is a line segment defined by points x2 (plural of entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo linji''' — line, '''lo se linji''' — points defining a line

'''linto''' — x1 (entity) is lightweight<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: In metaphorical sense '''se''' '''xalbo''' is light (not serious)
:'''lo linto''' — lightweight
:'''le mlatu verba cu linto''' — ''The kitten is lightweight.''
:Related words: '''junta''', '''tilju'''

'''lisri''' — x1 (text) is a story about x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lisri''' — story, tale, yarn, narrative, '''lo se lisri''' — plot of a story

'''liste''' — x1 (entity) is a list, log of x2 (plural of entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

:'''lo liste''' — list, log, '''lo se liste''' — logged

'''litki''' — x1 (entity) is liquid<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo litki''' — liquid

:Related words: '''cilmo''', '''djacu''', '''lumci''', '''runta''', '''pambe''', '''sudga''', '''gapci''', '''sligu''', '''flecu''', '''jduli'''

'''litru''' — x1 (entity) travels via route x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo litru''' — traveller, '''lo se litru''' — travelling route

'''livga''' — x1 (entity) is a liver of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo livga''' — liver
:'''xu lo ka citka lo livga be lo jipci cu xamgu do''' — ''Is eating chicken liver good for you?''

'''livla''' — x1 (entity) is a fuel for powering x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

:'''lo livla na banzu''' — ''There isn't enough fuel.''

'''lo''' — verb > noun


:Comment: ''the one which does ...'', ''the one which is ...'', ''those which do ...'', ''those which are ...''. Creates noun from verb. Often corresponds to English '-er' like in 'singer', 'player'. Without numbers specified can refer both to singular and plural nouns depending on context.
:'''lo mlatu cu danlu''' — ''Cat is an animal.''
:'''lo pa sazri ca denpa''' — ''A driver waits.''
:'''lo za'u sazri ca denpa''' — ''Drivers wait.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LE</small></span>

'''lo'ai''' — To correct yourself say '''lo'ai''', then the incorrect construct, then '''sa'ai''', then the same but corrected construct, then '''le'ai'''.


:Comment: You may just start with '''sa'ai''' if it's obvious what is corrected. The word '''le'ai''' on its own indicates that an obvious mistake was made. '''le'ai''' '''dai''' indicates that the other partner made a mistake. '''le'ai''' '''pei''' asks whether the partner made a mistake. '''le'ai''' '''nai''' explicitly denies mistakes.
:ends with: sa'ai
:'''i mi pu vitke lo dzipo le'ainai i mi pu klama lo zarci y lo'ai pu sa'ai ba le'ai''' — ''I visited Antarctique (sic!) I went to the store, ehm, no, will go!''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LOhAI</small></span>

'''lo'e''' — verb > noun denoting a typical thing


:Comment: ''the typical one that does or is ...''.
:'''lo'e cipni cu kakne lo ka vofli''' — ''Typical birds can fly.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LE</small></span>

'''lo'o'''
:starts with: LI<span style='float:right'><small>class: LOhO</small></span>

'''lo'u''' — main verb > noun that is a quote

:ends with: le'u
:'''ma smuni lo'u vau ua le'u noi do cusku''' — ''What's the meaning of '''vau ua''' that you said?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LOhU</small></span>

'''logji''' — x1 (proposition) is a logic for reasoning about x2 (proposition)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo logji''' — logic

'''loi''' — verb > noun denoting a mass

:'''lo lojbo''' — Lojbanic

'''loldi''' — x1 (entity) is a floor or ground of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

'''lorxu''' — x1 (entity) is a fox of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lorxu''' — fox
:'''lo lorxu cu citka lo jipci''' — ''Foxes eat hens.''
:Related words: '''gerku'''

'''lu''' — main verb > noun that is a quote


:Comment: '''lu''' ... '''li'u''' is a noun quoting grammatically correct text in Lojban (can contain any number of words).
:ends with: li'u
:'''mi pu cusku lu coi lo pendo li'u''' — ''I said Hello, friends!''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LU</small></span>

'''lu'e''' — ''what refers to'' (noun follows)


:Comment: '''''lu'e''' [noun]'' is the same as '''''lo''' '''sinxa''' '''be''' [noun]''.
:'''lo re cukla cu du lu'e lo logji''' — ''Two circles is a symbol of logic.''
:'''lo vi vorme janbe cu lu'e mi''' — ''This door bell is to call me.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LAhE</small></span>

'''lu'u'''
:starts with: LAhE<span style='float:right'><small>class: LUhU</small></span>

'''lujvo''' — x1 (text) is a lujvo, verb made of affixes with meaning x2 (entity) , arguments meaning x3 (ordered plural of entity) , with affixes built from components x4 (ordered plural of text)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lujvo''' — lujvo (compound verb made of affixes)
:'''zo ki'ogra lujvo lo du'u kilto lo grake vau lo kilto ce'o lo se grake zo kilto ce'o zo grake''' — '''''ki'ogra''' is a lujvo meaning is a thousand of grams with arguments meaning what is measured in thousands, the number of grams; affixes of the lujvo are built from '''kilto''' and '''grake''' attached sequentially.''
:Related words: '''stura''', '''cmavo''', '''gismu''', '''rafsi''', '''smuni'''

'''lumci''' — x1 (entity) washes x2 (entity) of contaminant x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lumci''' — washer
:'''mi pu lumci lo za'u palta lo stali''' — ''I washed the dishes of the remains.''
:Related words: '''djacu''', '''jinru''', '''litki''', '''zbabu''', '''jinsa''', '''curve'''

'''lunbe''' — x1 (entity) is naked or bare<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lunbe''' — naked, bare
:'''lo cifnu ca lunbe''' — ''The baby is naked.''
:Related words: '''taxfu''', '''bandu'''

'''lunra''' — x1 (entity) is a moon or major natural satellite of planet x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lunra''' — moon, '''lo se lunra''' — planet with a moon
:'''le terdi ce se lunra pa da''' — ''The Earth has one natural moon.''
:Related words: '''planeta''', '''solri''', '''terdi''', '''mluni'''

'''lunsa''' — x1 (entity) condenses<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo lunsa''' — condensing
:'''lo bisli lunsa pu gacri lo dertu''' — ''The frost covered the ground.''
:Related words: '''cilmo''', '''dunja''', '''febvi''', '''runme''', '''bumru'''

'''luska''' — x1 is a mollusc of species x2<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo luska''' — mollusc
:'''lo vi luska cu cpare co masno''' — ''This mollusc moves slowly.''
:Related words: '''curmu''', '''danlu''', '''xamsi''', '''rirxe'''

'''ly''' — letter 'L' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>

<span style='float:right'><small>class: BY2</small></span>

'''ma''' — asks for the noun (that should go into the place to which '''ma''' is put) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''do djica ma''' — ''What do you want?''
:'''ma poi prenu pu zvati ti''' — ''Who was here?''
:'''ma poi dacti pu zvati ti''' — ''What object was here?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA7</small></span>

'''ma'a''' — ''we with you'' (might include other persons not in the dialog) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:Comment: '''mi'ai''' is a more vague pronoun.
:'''ma'a se zdani lo bu'u planeta''' — ''We inhabit this planet.''
:'''lo rarna munje cu vajni ca lo nu ma'a se lifri''' — ''Nature plays an important role in our lives.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''ma'i''' — ''in reference frame ...'' <small>''[preposition from {manri}]''</small>


:'''According to my friend the situation is deteriorating.''' — ''ma'i lo mi pendo lo tcini cu zenba lo ka xlali.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''ma'oi''' — quotes one next word and treats it as the name of a selma'o (class of particles). The quoted word must be delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespace (in writing) 


:Comment: selma'o are often written in English text in capital letters e.g.: COI.
:'''zo di'ai cmavo ma'oi coi''' — '''''di'ai''' ('Good luck!') is a grammatical particle of class '''coi'''.''
:Related words: '''ra'oi''', '''zo'oi'''

'''ma'u''' — plus sign; positive number; default any positive <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:'''li ma'u re du li bi vu'u xa''' — ''+2 = 8 - 6'.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA3</small></span>

'''mabla''' — x1 (entity) is shitty, awful in x2 (property of x1) according to x3 (entity); ; x1 stinks, sucks<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mabla''' — shitty, awful, execrable, deplorable, wretched, rotten, miserable, contemptible, crappy, inferior, of low-quality
:'''fi mi le cidja cu mabla lo ka se zalvi lo denci''' — ''For me the food is awful in chewing it.''
:Related words: '''palci''', '''dapma''', '''xlali''', '''zabna''', '''funca''', '''ganti''', '''ganxo''', '''gletu''', '''gutra''', '''kalci''', '''pinca''', '''pinji''', '''plibu''', '''vibna''', '''vlagi''', '''zargu'''

'''mabru''' — x1 (entity) is mammal of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mabru''' — mammal
:'''lo delfinu cu mabru''' — ''Dolphins are mammals.''
:Related words: '''danlu''', '''ladru''', '''tatru''', '''ractu''', '''xanto''', '''xarju'''

'''macnu''' — x1 (entity) is manual in function x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: ??? depends on nilsutra
:'''lo macnu''' — manual, '''lo se macnu''' — function done manually
:'''```lo vi karce cu macnu lo ka cnegau lo ni ce'u sutra ''' — ''The speed in this machine is switched manually.''
:Related words: '''zmiku''', '''jitro'''

'''magneti''' — x1 (entity) is magnetic in x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo magneti''' — magnet
:'''lo rokci cu magneti lo ka snipa lo jinme''' — ''The stone is magnetic in that it sticks to metal.''
:'''lo rokci co'u magneti lo ka co'a glare''' — ''The stone becomes non-magnetic when being heat up.''
:Related words: '''letri''', '''trina''', '''xlura'''

'''mai''' — number > numbered item or paragraph


:Comment: suffix of a number that marks a paragraph or item when they are ordered.
:'''pamai la meilis ze'i se zdani ti''' — ''First, Mei Li has been living here for a short time.''
:'''remai my. ka'e sidju ma'a''' — ''Secondly, she can help us.''
:'''romai my. stati nixli''' — ''Lastly, she is a smart girl.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: MAI</small></span>

'''makcu''' — x1 (entity) is mature in x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo makcu''' — mature
:'''le nanmu cu simlu lo ka makcu lo ka seksi''' — ''The man seems to be mature in his sexuality.''
:Related words: '''cifnu''', '''ninmu''', '''verba''', '''banro''', '''farvi''', '''nanmu'''

'''makfa''' — x1 (event) is magic or supernatural to x2 (entity) performed by x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo makfa''' — magical event, '''lo te makfa''' — wizard, magician
:'''lo nu lo ractu cu canci cu makfa lo verba la djan''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''krici''', '''manci'''

'''malsi''' — x1 (entity) is a church or temple of religion, culture x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo malsi''' — church, temple
:'''ti malsi lo budjo''' — ''This is a Buddhist temple.''
:Related words: '''cevni''', '''krici''', '''lijda''', '''ritli'''

'''mamta''' — x1 (entity) is a mother of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mamta''' — mother, '''lo se mamta''' — child of a mother
:'''lo mamta be do pu zukte ma ca lo nu do mo'u klama lo zdani''' — ''What was your mother doing when you got home?''
:Related words: '''patfu''', '''sovda''', '''rirni''', '''rorci''', '''tarbi''', '''famti''', '''bersa''', '''jbena'''

'''manfo''' — x1 (entity) is uniform, homogeneous in x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo manfo''' — uniform, homogeneous
:'''le bukpu ca manfo lo ka se tengu''' — ''The cloth is uniform in texture.''
:Related words: '''prane''', '''curve''', '''ranji''', '''vitno''', '''stodi''', '''dikni''', '''sampu''', '''traji'''

'''mango''' — x1 (entity) is a mango of variety x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mango''' — mango
:'''mi punai citka lo mango''' — ''I have never eaten mangoes.''
:Related words: '''grute'''

'''manku''' — x1 (entity) is dark<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo manku''' — dark
:'''lo kumfa cu manku''' — ''The room is dark.''
:Related words: '''blabi''', '''gusni''', '''ctino''', '''kandi''', '''xekri''', '''ctino'''

'''manri''' — x1 (entity) is a standard for observing x2 (entity) with rules x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo manri''' — standard
:'''mi manri lo nu makau ba jinga vau lo ka jdice makau''' — ''I'm the standard of determining of who will win, however I decide that will be so.''
:'''lo vu ve'i cmana ba manri lo nu zgana le tumla''' — ''That hill will be the reference frame for bserving the land.''
:Related words: '''ma'i''', '''ckilu''', '''merli''', '''pajni''', '''cimde''', '''jdice''', '''marde'''

'''mansa''' — x1 (entity) satisfies x2 (entity) in x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mansa''' — satisfying, '''lo se mansa''' — satisfied
:'''lo zdani be mi cu mansa mi lo ka tcini bu'u ce'u''' — ''I'm satisfied with the conditions in my house.''
:Related words: '''pajni'''

'''manti''' — x1 (entity) is an ant of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo manti''' — ant
:'''lo sakta cu trina lo manti''' — ''Sugar attracts ants.''
:Related words: '''cinki''', '''blato'''

'''mapku''' — x1 (entity) is a hat, helmet<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mapku''' — hat, helmet
:'''ai mi dasni lo mapku''' — ''I'm gonna put on a hat.''
:Related words: '''taxfu''', '''stedu''', '''drudi'''

'''mapni''' — x1 (entity) is some cotton<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mapni''' — cotton
:'''le mapni cu zabna''' — ''The cotton is of high quality.''
:Related words: '''bukpu'''

'''mapti''' — x1 (entity) is compatible with or matches x2 (entity) in x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mapti''' — compatible
:'''lo se cusku be do na mapti lo se cusku be lo do jatna lo ka se smuni''' — ''Your words are inconsistent in meaning with what your boss said.''
:'''ti ckiku lo na mapti be lo vi stela''' — ''The key is incompatible with this lock.''
:Related words: '''satci''', '''tugni''', '''sarxe''', '''drani''', '''tarmi''', '''ckini''', '''mintu'''

'''marbi''' — x1 (entity) is a shelter protecting x2 (entity) against threat x3 (property of x2)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo marbi''' — shelter, haven, refuge, retreat, harbor
:'''mi pu jai se bapli fai lo ka se marbi lo laldo dinju fi lo ka cilmo''' — ''I had to take shelter in an old building in order not to become wet.''
:Related words: '''bandu''', '''ckape''', '''snura''', '''drudi''', '''sepli''', '''bitmu''', '''gacri'''

'''marce''' — x1 (entity) is a vehicle for carrying x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo marce''' — vehicle, '''lo se marce''' — passenger
:'''ti marce lo se vecnu''' — ''This is a vehicle for carrying goods.''
:'''ti marce ge lo se vecnu na'o ku gi lo remna ca'aku''' — ''This is a vehicle intended to transport goods but actually used for transporting people.''
:Related words: '''klama''', '''matra''', '''bevri''', '''bloti''', '''carce''', '''karce''', '''sabnu''', '''skiji'''

'''marde''' — x1 (property of x2) are the ethics of performer x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo marde''' — ethics, morals, moral standards, ethical standards
:'''lo ka zukte lo se cpedu be lo bilma cu marde ei do''' — ''Doing what the ill person asks should be you ethics.''
:Related words: '''palci''', '''vrude''', '''lijda''', '''manri''', '''javni''', '''tarti''', '''zekri'''

'''margu''' — x1 (entity) is a quantity of mercury<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo margu''' — mercury
:'''xu lo margu cu jinme''' — ''Is mercury a metal?''
:Related words: '''jinme'''

'''marji''' — x1 (entity) is material of composition x2 (entity) in shape x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo marji''' — material, stuff, matter, '''lo se marji''' — composition of matter, '''lo te marji''' — shape of matter
:'''lo vi nanba cu marji lo mraji lo bliku''' — ''This bread is made of rye and has the form of a block.''
:Related words: '''morna''', '''mucti''', '''nejni''', '''tarmi''', '''dacti'''

'''marna''' — x1 (entity) is a quantity of hemp of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo marna''' — hemp
:'''ti skori lo marna''' — ''This is a cable made of hemp.''
:Related words: '''skori''', '''tanko''', '''sigja''', '''xukmi'''

'''marvele''' — x1 (entity) is marvellous, astonishing to x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo marvele''' — marvellous
:'''lo vi stuzi cu marvele mi''' — ''This place is marveleus to me.''
:Related words: '''melbi'''

'''marxa''' — x1 (entity) crushes or smashes x2 (entity) into x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''mi pu marxa lo patlu lo pesxu''' — ''I made mashed potatoes.''
:Related words: '''daspo''', '''pesxu''', '''zalvi''', '''bapli'''

'''masno''' — x1 (entity) is slow at doing x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo masno''' — slow
:'''le verba cu simlu lo ka masno lo ka cadzu''' — ''The child seems to be slow at walking.''
:Related words: '''sutra'''

'''masti''' — x1 (event) is x2 (number) months long<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo pu dunra cu masti li ci''' — ''The past winter lasted for 3 months.''
:Related words: '''detri''', '''djedi''', '''jeftu''', '''nanca'''

'''matci''' — x1 (entity) is a mat or pad<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo matci''' — mat, pad
:'''ko jai mosra lo cutci lo matci''' — ''Wipe your shoes on the mat.''
:Related words: '''kicne''', '''tapla''', '''karda''', '''ckana'''

'''matli''' — x1 (entity) is some flax, linen<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo matli''' — linen
:'''lo vi creka cu matli''' — ''This shirt is linen.''
:Related words: '''bukpu'''

'''matne''' — x1 (entity) is some butter<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo matne''' — butter
:'''mi pu citka lo snuji be lo matne bei lo nanba''' — ''I ate a sandwich with butter and bread.''
:Related words: '''grasu''', '''kruji'''

'''matra''' — x1 (entity) is an engine driving x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo matra''' — engine
:'''lo vi karce cu se matra lo vlipa''' — ''This car has a powerful engine.''
:Related words: '''marce''', '''minji''', '''carce'''

'''mau''' — ''more ...'' <small>''[preposition from {zmadu}]''</small>


:Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo se zmadu''' — ''than...', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo zmadu''' — ''more ...', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te zmadu''' — the comparison.
:'''mi nelci do mau la alis''' — ''I like you but Alice likes you more.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''mau'i''' — stronger intensity interjection. Used as a modifier of interjections <small>''[interjection modifier]''</small>


:Comment: specifies an intensity of an interjection stronger than the intensity of the same interjection earlier used.
:'''ua do ti zvati''' — ''Wow, you are here.''
:'''uamau'i ji'a la alis ti zvati''' — ''Wow, wow, Alice is here too!''
:Related words: '''dau'i''', '''mau'i''', '''me'ai''', '''cu'i''', '''sai''', '''ru'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: CAI2</small></span>

'''mavji''' — x1 (entity) is some oats of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mavji''' — oats
:'''ze'uku lo mavji gau ralju cidja lo xirma''' — ''Oats have long been the main food for horses.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''

'''maxri''' — x1 (entity) is some wheat of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo maxri''' — wheat
:'''lo nanba cu se zbasu fi lo maxri''' — ''Bread is made of wheat.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''

'''me''' — ''x1 is among the referents of ...'' (a noun follows)


:ends with: me'u
:'''xu do me lo ctuca''' — ''Are you a teacher?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ME</small></span>

'''me'ai''' — weaker intensity interjection. Used as a modifier of interjections <small>''[interjection modifier]''</small>


:Comment: specifies an intensity of an interjection weaker than the intensity of the same interjection earlier used.
:'''ua do tsuku doi la alis''' — ''Wow, you arrived, Alice!''
:'''uame'ai lo drata ti zvati ji'a''' — ''Oh well, the others are here too.''
:Related words: '''dau'i''', '''mau'i''', '''me'ai''', '''cu'i''', '''sai''', '''ru'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: CAI2</small></span>

'''me'i''' — less than <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:'''me'i mu prenu ca zutse bu'u le kumfa''' — ''There are less than five people sitting in the room now.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA3</small></span>

'''me'o''' — number > text


:Comment: marks the following sequence of numbers as a text.
:'''me'o pa re ci''' — ''123 (as a text).''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LI</small></span>

'''me'oi''' — foreign word > verb


:Comment: '''me'oi''' and one single word after it make a verb. The word after '''me'oi''': might be from any language and written in any script, it is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides, it can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written. A quick way to borrow foreign words into Lojban.
:'''la alis cu me'oi slob''' — ''Alice is a slob.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZOhOI</small></span>

'''me'u'''
:starts with: ME<span style='float:right'><small>class: MEhU</small></span>

'''mebri''' — x1 (entity) is a brow or forehead of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mebri''' — brow
:'''le fetsi pu se mebri lo kalri''' — ''She had a forehead open.''
:Related words: '''stedu''', '''flira'''

'''megdo''' — x1 (entity) is a million of x2 (same type as x1) in x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''mi ponse lo megdo lo rupnu be li ci''' — ''I own three million dollars.''
:'''e'o do cuxna fi lo pixra poi klani su'e lo megdo be li pa bei lo ka se bitri li bi''' — ''Please choose an image that does not exceed 1 Megabyte.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti''', '''zetro'''

'''mei''' — number > verb denoting mass <small>''[verb]''</small>


:Comment: x1 (entity) is the mass formed from (n) members that are x2 (plural of entity). The number (n) is put in front of '''mei'''.
:'''mi ralte lo re mei be lo gluta''' — ''I have a pair of mittens.''
:Related words: '''cmima''', '''gunma''', '''moi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: MOI</small></span>

'''mekso''' — x1 (text) is a mathematical expression under rules x2 (proposition)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mekso''' — math expression
:'''lu li vo du li re su'i re li'u mekso la .lojban.''' — ''li vo du li resu'i re is a mathematical expression in Lojban.''
:'''zoi cy.(x+15&~15).cy. mekso la .c. poi bangu''' — ''x+15&~15 is a mathematical expression in C language.''
:Related words: '''cmaci''', '''dilcu''', '''fancu''', '''frinu''', '''jalge''', '''namcu''', '''parbi''', '''pilji'''

'''melbi''' — x1 (entity) is beautiful to observer x2 (entity) in aspect x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo melbi''' — beautiful
:'''le ninmu cu melbi mi lo ka se catlu''' — ''For me the woman is beautiful to look at.''
:Related words: '''pluka''', '''xamgu'''

'''menli''' — x1 (event) is a mind of body x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: Ability of being aware of things and of rational thought
:'''lo menli''' — mind
:'''lo menli be lo smani cu simsa lo menli be lo remna''' — ''The mind of monkeys is similar to the one of humans.''
:Related words: '''intele''', '''besna''', '''morji''', '''mucti''', '''pensi''', '''sanji''', '''xanri''', '''sevzi''', '''xadni'''

'''mensi''' — x1 (entity) is a sister of x2 (entity) by bond x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mensi''' — sister, '''lo se mensi''' — sibling of a sister
:'''do mensi mi lo ka se patfu''' — ''You are my brother since we are born from the same father.''
:Related words: '''bruna''', '''tunba''', '''tamne''', '''famti'''

'''mentu''' — x1 (event) is x2 (number) minutes long<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo nu penmi cu mentu be li ji'i xano''' — ''The meeting is approximately 60 minutes long.''
:Related words: '''junla''', '''cacra''', '''snidu''', '''tcika'''

'''merli''' — x1 (entity) measures x2 (entity) as x3 (number) units on x4 (property of x2 and x3) with accuracy x5 (number)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo merli''' — measurer, '''lo se merli''' — measured
:'''mi merli le jubme li pa lo ka mitre vau li pipa''' — ''I measured the length of the table as 1 meter with accuracy 0.1 meters.''
:Related words: '''kancu''', '''rupnu''', '''fepni''', '''dekpu''', '''gutci''', '''minli''', '''merli''', '''bunda''', '''ckilu''', '''gradu''', '''satci''', '''centi''', '''cimde''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''kramu''', '''litce''', '''manri''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti''', '''zetro'''

'''mi''' — ''I'' (the speaker or the speakers) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''mi gleki''' — ''I'm happy.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''mi'a''' — ''we without you'' (might include other persons not in the dialog) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:Comment: '''mi'ai''' is a more vague pronoun.
:'''mi'a pu casnu do''' — ''We were discussing you.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''mi'ai''' — ''we'' (at least two persons including at least one of the speakers) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:Comment: English 'we'. '''mi'a''', '''mi'o''' and '''ma'a''' are more specific cases of '''mi'ai'''.
:'''mi'ai serai troci''' — ''We try our best.''
:'''mi'ai djuno lo krinu''' — ''We know the reason.''
:'''da mi'ai nabmi''' — ''We have a problem.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''mi'e''' — ''I am ...'' (self-identification of the speaker) <small>''[vocative]''</small>

'''mi'enai''' — ''I am not'' (denial of the speaker's identity)
:'''coi mi'e la gleki''' — ''Hello, I'm La Gleki.''
:'''coi la kevin i mi'enai la kevin''' — ''Hello, Kevin - I'm not Kevin.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: COI</small></span>

'''mi'i''' — ''from center of ... and of distance ... around'' <small>''[conjunction]''</small>


:'''lo za'u flora cu zvati lo cmana mi'i lo ki'otre be li ci''' — ''The flowers are present on the mountain and three kilometers around of it.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BIhI</small></span>

'''mi'o''' — ''you and I'' (the speaker and the listener) <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:Comment: '''mi'ai''' is a more vague pronoun.
:'''mi'o ba renvi''' — ''You and I will survive.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA3</small></span>

'''mi'u''' — ''ditto'' (the same thing) — another one <small>''[discursive]''</small>


:Comment: ??? aNAPHORA.
:'''mi pu zukte ra mi'u i mi pu lebna lo cukta gi'e dunda lo cukta mi'u nai la .alis.
''' — ''I did the same thing. I took a book and gave another one to Alice.''
:Related words: '''mintu'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3b</small></span>

'''midju''' — x1 (entity) is in the middle of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''ra pu sanli bu'u lo midju be lo dargu''' — ''He was standing in the middle of the road.''
:Related words: '''lanxe''', '''jbini''', '''nutli''', '''snuji''', '''milxe''', '''denmi''', '''ralju'''

'''mifra''' — x1 (entity, text) is an encoded x2 (entity, text) made using cipher x3 (entity, property (contains two places for '''ce'u'''))<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mifra''' — encrypted text, '''lo se mifra''' — not encrypted text, '''lo te mifra''' — cipher for encryption
:'''zoi mifr cni rni dn mifr mifra lu coi ro do li'u lo ka zo o pe ce'u se basti zo n pe ce'u''' — ''cni rni dn is an encoded Lojban phrase '''coi ro do''' where '''n''' is a replacement for '''o'''.''

'''mikce''' — x1 (entity) cures or treats x2 (entity) for disease x3 (event); ; x1 is a doctor<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo mikce''' — doctor, '''lo se mikce''' — patient (being cured), '''lo te mikce''' — disease cured

no boi lo ka ganra''' — ''The table is 800 millimeters wide.''

'''mo'e''' — noun > number


:Comment: turns the following noun into a number to be used in math operations.
:ends with: te'u

'''mo'i''' — marks event as reaching the state specified by the clause following '''mo'i'''

'''mo'o''' — number > numbered chapter


:Comment: suffix of a number that marks a chapter or section when they are ordered.

'''mo'u''' — completing, being at the expected end (completive or telic aspect) <small>''[preposition]''</small>

'''mo'unai''' — not having an end (incompletive or atelic aspect)
:'''mi mo'u cirko''' — ''I've lost it.''
:'''mi mo'u citka lo ro plise''' — ''I've eaten up all apples.''
:'''mo'unaiku mi pu zbasu lo dinju ze'a lo masti''' — ''I built houses for a month.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZAhO</small></span>

'''moi''' — number > verb denoting ordinal position <small>''[verb]''</small>


:Comment: x1 (entity) is the n-th member of x2 (entity) ordered by rule x3 (relation between members of x2, contains two places for '''ce'u'''). The number (n) is put in front of '''moi'''. The two '''ce'u''' in the third place can specify the sequence in which members of the set are compared..
:'''lo vi cukta cu me mi moi''' — ''This book is mine.''
:'''i mi ci moi lo pendo lo ka ce'u ce'u cinba''' — ''I kiss all but two of my friends.''
:'''lo cmaci cu romoi lo saske lo ka ce'u ce'u zmadu fi lo ka mi djica lo ka tadni makau''' — ''Math is the last subject that I want to study.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: MOI</small></span>

:'''ti pulni lo nu cpacu lo djacu lo jinto vau lo mudri''' — ''This is a wooden pulley to lift water from the well.''
:Related words: '''tutci''', '''xislu''', '''vraga'''

'''punji''' — x1 (entity) places or puts x2 (entity, property of x3) at x3 (entity, property of x2)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>, '''lo se punji''' — placed
:'''doi nobli .e'o ko punji lo ka virnu kei lo mi risna''' — ''Lord, put courage into my heart!''
:'''lo skina pu punji mi lo ka gleki cinmo''' — ''The movie put me in a happy mood.''
:Related words: '''cpacu''', '''lebna''', '''cpana''', '''batke''', '''setca'''

'''punli''' — x1 (entity) is a swelling, clump on x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo punli''' — swelling, clump
:'''pu snime punli lo dargu''' — ''It was a clump of snow on the road.''
:'''da punli lo stedu be mi''' — ''I have a swelling on my head.''
:Related words: '''balji''', '''cmana''', '''plana'''

'''purci''' — x1 (event) is earlier than or in the past of x2 (event)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo purci''' — earlier event, past event, '''lo se purci''' — later event, future event
:'''lo nu la kevin cu cliva pu purci lo nu mi tsuku lo xotli''' — ''Kevin left earlier than I arrived at the hotel.''
:Related words: '''lidne''', '''balvi''', '''cabna''', '''farna'''

'''purdi''' — x1 (entity) is a garden or field of family or gardener x2 (entity) growing crops x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo purdi''' — garden, '''lo se purdi''' — gardener, '''lo te purdi''' — crops of a garden
:'''ti purdi loi mi rirni lo vrici''' — ''This ia my parents' garden growing different crops.''
:Related words: '''foldi''', '''cange''', '''panka'''

'''purmo''' — x1 (entity) is some powder of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo purmo''' — powder
:'''ti purmo lo gurni''' — ''This is a flour.''
:Related words: '''pulce''', '''zalvi'''

'''py''' — letter 'P' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>

<span style='float:right'><small>class: BY2</small></span>

'''ra''' — a recent completed noun <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''la alis pu tsuku lo zarci gi'e te vecnu lo plise''' — ''Alice entered a store and bought apples.''
:'''babo ra klama lo zdani''' — ''Then she went home.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA5</small></span>

'''ra'e''' — infinite number of the same digit follows <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:'''li pa fi'u ci du li pi ra'e ci''' — ''1/3 equals 0.(3)'.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA3</small></span>

'''ra'i''' — ''from source, origin, starting point ...'' <small>''[preposition from {krasi}]''</small>


:'''mi pu ganse lo pluka panci pe ra'i le purdi''' — ''I felt a pleasant smell from the garden.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''ra'o''' — put after particles of group GOhA and updates its meaning from the viewpoint of the current speaker


:'''- mi se pluka lo ka penmi do - go'i ra'o''' — ''- I am pleased to meet you. - Me too.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: RAhO</small></span>

'''ra'oi''' — quotes one next word and treats it as a rafsi. The quoted word must be delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespace (in writing) 


:Comment: rafsi sometimes can be not legal words on their own so to quote them '''ra'oi''' is useful.
:'''ra'oi kla rafsi zo klama''' — '''''kla''' is an affix from the full verb '''klama'''.''
:Related words: '''ma'oi''', '''zo'oi'''

'''ra'u''' — ''primarily'', ''mainly'' (in importance) <small>''[discursive]''</small>

'''ra'ucu'i''' — ''equally'' (in importance)

'''ra'unai''' — ''incidentally'' (low in importance)
:'''ra'u ko tolxanka denpa''' — ''Above all, be patient.''
:'''ei mi gunka ije ra'ucu'i ei mi surla''' — ''I need to work.''
:'''ra'unai mi na se spaji''' — ''But with equal importance I need to relax. Incidentally, I'm not surprised.''
:Related words: '''ralju''', '''vajni'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3</small></span>

'''racli''' — x1 (entity) is rational or sane<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo racli''' — rational event, sane event
:'''racli fau da'i''' — ''That would make sense.''
:'''facli fa lonu do pu cuxna lo ka tavla bau la .lojban.''' — ''It's rational that you chose to talk in Lojban.''

'''ractu''' — x1 (entity) is a rabbit of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

:'''lo ractu fi'o sutra co'a se panzi''' — ''Rabbits breed quickly.''

'''rai''' — ''with superlative ...'' <small>''[preposition from {traji}]''</small>

'''raktu''' — x1 (entity) disturbs person x2 (entity) causing problems x3 (property of x2)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>, '''lo se raktu''' — disturbed

:'''lo ralte''' — keeper, '''lo se ralte''' — kept
