:'''mi pu rivbi lo ka bilma vau lo ka zenba lo ka citka vau gi'e jinru lo glare djacu''' — ''I avoided becoming ill by eating more and plunging into hot water.''
:'''le prenu pu rivbi loi pulji''' — ''The person evaded the police.''
:Related words: '''bandu''', '''fanta''', '''se''' '''jersi''', '''sisku''', '''kalte''', '''fapro'''

'''ro''' — each, all <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:'''ro lo mi pendo cu cusku lo se du'u mi simlu lo ka tatpi''' — ''All of my friends say that I look tired.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA4</small></span>

'''ro'a''' — interacting socially (communication, customs) <small>''[emotion category/modifier]''</small>

'''ro'acu'i''' — not focused towards interacting socially

'''ro'anai''' — focused away from interacting socially
:Comment: used without an attitudinal to indicate focus of the speaker..
:'''oi ro'a caku mi se cfipu''' — ''Awkward .''
:'''ui ro'a cu'i mi cikre lo mi skami''' — ''I'm confused.''
:'''uinairo'a no da zvati ti''' — ''I'm just puttering here by myself, fixing my computer. I feel so lonely, nobody is here.''
:Related words: '''jikca'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI4</small></span>

'''ro'e''' — mental/intellectual/thought aspect <small>''[emotion category/modifier]''</small>

'''ro'ecu'i''' — not focused towards contemplating

'''ro'enai''' — mindless action
:Comment: used without an interjection to indicate focus of the speaker..
:'''uiro'e mi morji''' — ''Yay, I remember!''
:'''.a'i ro'e cu'i mi ba zukte''' — ''I will do it not putting much intellectual effort.''
:'''do marveli iuro'enai''' — ''There is no logic in it, you are just wonderful.''
:Related words: '''menli'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI4</small></span>

'''ro'i''' — emotionally <small>''[emotion category/modifier]''</small>

'''ro'icu'i''' — non-emotionally

'''ro'inai''' — denying emotions
:'''uiro'isai mi'a jinga''' — ''I'm just overwhelmed with emotions, we won!!''

:'''uiro'icu'i mi kanro''' — ''Feelings apart, I'm healthy.''
:'''uiro'inaido snada''' — ''No rejoicing from me, you won.''
:Related words: '''cinmo'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI4</small></span>

'''ro'o''' — restricted physical body <small>''[emotion category/modifier]''</small>

'''ro'ocu'i''' — not oriented towards physical experience

'''ro'onai''' — denying physical experience

:'''ii ro'o cu'i ka'e kargu''' — ''I'm afraid it can be expensive.''
:'''ii ro'o nai mi na drani punji le tanxe''' — ''No, not that it requires physical work, but I'm afraid I might not put the box correctly.''

'''ro'u''' — sexually <small>''[emotion category/modifier]''</small>

:'''seja'e lo nu mi pu cinmo lo mabla vau mi pu gunka no da''' — ''Because of my bad mood I didn't work.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''se'a''' — self-sufficiency <small>''[interjection modifier]''</small>

'''se'anai''' — dependency
:'''fa se'a le verba pu kelci''' — ''The child played by himself.''
:'''fa se'anai le cifnu cu cadzu''' — ''The infant walks but not by himself.''
:Related words: '''sezysei''', '''kantcu'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI5</small></span>

'''se'i''' — interjection is self-oriented <small>''[interjection modifier]''</small>

'''se'inai''' — interjection is oriented towards others.
:'''oi se'i mi pu srera''' — ''Oh, I made a mistake.''
:'''oi se'i nai da spofu botpi bu'u lo loldi''' — ''Someone would be discontented, there is a broken bottle on the floor.''
:Related words: '''sevzi''', '''drata'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI5</small></span>

'''se'o''' — ''I know from a dream, vision, or personal revelation'' <small>''[evidential]''</small>


:Comment: '''za'a''' is for expressing external experience, '''se'o''' is for expressing internal experience..
:'''se'o do ba snada''' — ''I have a feeling you will succeed.''
:Related words: '''senva'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI2</small></span>

'''se'u'''
:starts with: SEI<span style='float:right'><small>class: SEhU</small></span>

'''seba'i''' — ''instead'', ''being a replacement of ...'' <small>''[preposition from {se} {basti}]''</small>


:'''seba'iku mi pu citka lo torta''' — ''Instead, I ate a cake.''
:'''mi ne seba'i do pu zukte''' — ''I did it instead of you.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''secau''' — ''lacking ...'' <small>''[preposition from {se} {claxu}]''</small>


:'''lo mi pendo ce mi pu tsuku lo cizra stuzi secau lo ka sanji lo du'u ka'e ckape''' — ''My friend and I arrived at a strange place lacking the awareness that it can be dangerous.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''sefta''' — x1 (entity) is a surface of object x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo sefta''' — surface
:'''lo sefta be lo najnimre cu xutla''' — ''The orange has a soft surface.''

'''sei''' — verb > interjection

'''seka'a''' — ''going to ...'' <small>''[preposition from {se} {klama}]''</small>


:'''mi pu cadzu seka'a le rirxe''' — ''I walked to the river.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''seksi''' — x1 (entity) in activity or state x2 (property of x1) exhibits biological or social sexuality x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: ???see erotic
:'''lo seksi''' — sexy, '''lo se seksi''' — sexual activity, '''lo te seksi''' — social gender, biological gender
:'''lo vi finpe ca seksi lo ka punji lo sovda vau lo ka fetsi''' — ''This fish demonstrates its female sexuality by laying eggs.''
:'''do seksi lo ka se asna vau lo ka ninmu le tigni cu seksi lo ka dasni lo tordu skaci vau lo ka ninmu''' — ''You took a sexy feminine pose. The actor shows her female sexuality by wearing a short skirt.''

'''selci''' — x1 (entity) is a cell, atom, basic subunit of body x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

'''semau''' — ''more than ...'' <small>''[preposition from {se} {zmadu}]''</small>


:Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo zmadu''' — ''more', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se zmadu''' — ''than ...', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te zmadu''' — the comparison.

:'''mi nelci do pe semau la alis''' — ''I like you more than Alice.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''seme'a''' — ''less than ...'' <small>''[preposition from {se} {mleca}]''</small>


:Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo mleca''' — ''less', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se mleca''' — ''less than ...', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te mleca''' — the comparison.

'''senci''' — x1 (entity) sneezes<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

:Related words: '''bilma''', '''kafke'''

'''seni'i''' — ''logically'', ''logically because ...'' <small>''[preposition from {nibli}]''</small>

:'''mi pu na zvati le tcadu''' — ''However, it doesn't follow from that that all animals are dogs.''

'''seni'i''' — ''logically'', ''logically because ...'' <small>''[preposition from {nibli}]''</small>


:'''ro gerku cu danlu .iseni'inai bo ro danlu cu gerku''' — ''All dogs are animals.''
:'''mi pu na zvati le tcadu''' — ''However, it doesn't follow from that that all animals are dogs.''
:'''seni'i bo ka'enai ku mi penmi la kevin''' — ''I wasn't in the city so I couldn't meet Alice.''
:'''ro gerku cu danlu .iseni'inai bo ro danlu cu gerku''' — ''All dogs are animals. However, that doesn't mean that all animals are dogs.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''serai'''
:Comment: the preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se traji''' — comparison, x1 of the clause corresponds to the most one in this comparison.

'''si'e''' — number > verb denoting portion <small>''[verb]''</small>

:'''le taxfu cu tarti lo ka pinta''' — ''The dress is strained in horizontal direction.''
:Related words: '''tinsa''', '''torni''', '''tagji''', '''tcena''', '''kluza'''

'''trene''' — x1 (entity) is a train of cars x2 (plural of entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo trene''' — train (of cars), '''lo se trene''' — car of a train, carriage (of a train)
:'''ti trene mu da''' — ''This train consists of 5 cars.''
:Related words: '''tcana'''

'''tricu''' — x1 (entity) is a tree of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tricu''' — tree
:'''lo cribe cu kakne lo ka cpare lo tricu''' — ''A bear can climb a tree.''
:Related words: '''cindu''', '''ckunu''', '''pezli''', '''mudri''', '''spati'''

'''trina''' — x1 (entity) attracts x2 (entity) with x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo trina''' — attractive, '''lo se trina''' — attracted
:'''lo jibri cu trina mi lo ka mi zifre lo ka cliva lo briju ca lo nu mi djica''' — ''The job attracts me in that I may leave the office when I want.''
:Related words: '''djica''', '''nelci''', '''rigni''', '''xlura''', '''magneti'''

'''trixe''' — x1 (entity) is behind x2 (entity) in frame of reference x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo karce cu trixe lo tricu lo canko''' — ''The car is behind the tree when viewed from the window.''
:Related words: '''crane''', '''rebla''', '''mlana''', '''pritu''', '''zunle'''

'''troci''' — x1 (entity) tries to do x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>, '''lo se troci''' — something tried
:'''mi ba troci lo ka cpare lo tricu''' — ''I will try to climb the tree.''
:'''fa po'o lo troci cu snada''' — ''Only the one who tries succeeds.''
:'''ku'i lo troci po'o cu fliba''' — ''But the one who only tries fails.''
:Related words: '''fliba''', '''snada''', '''cipra'''

'''tsali''' — x1 (entity) is strong in property x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tsali''' — strong
:'''do tsali lo ka lafti lo tilju''' — ''You are strong in lifting heavy objects.''
:Related words: '''ralci''', '''ruble''', '''carmi''', '''vlipa'''

'''tsani''' — x1 (entity) is the sky at place x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tsani''' — sky
:'''lo tsani be lo xamsi cu klina gi'e banli''' — ''The sky in the sea is clean and magnificent.''
:Related words: '''gapru''', '''kensa''', '''tarci''', '''terdi'''

'''tsapi''' — x1 (entity) is a spice or seasoning causing flavor x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tsapi''' — spice, seasoning, '''lo se tsapi''' — flavour of a seasoning, flavor of a seasoning
:'''lo vi cidja cu culno lo tsapi be lo cpina''' — ''This food is rich in hot spices.''
:Related words: '''vrusi'''

'''tsiju''' — x1 (entity) is a seed, fertilized cell of organism x2 (entity) for producing offspring x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tsiju''' — seed, fertilized cell
:'''ti tsiju lo manti lo mamta''' — ''This is a fertilized cell producing ant queen.''
:Related words: '''tarbi''', '''dembi''', '''grute''', '''jbari''', '''sombo''', '''spati''', '''sovda'''

'''tsina''' — x1 (entity) is a platform or stage at x2 (entity) supporting x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tsina''' — platform, stage
:'''lo tsani cu tsina pe'a lo galtu lo tarci''' — ''The sky is a high pedestral for stars.''
:Related words: '''greku''', '''jubme'''

'''tsuku''' — x1 (entity) arrives at x2 (entity, property of x1) via x3 (entity); ; x1 reaches x2<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>, '''lo se tsuku''' — place of arrival
:'''mi tsuku lo xotli lo ralju klaji''' — ''I arrived at the hotel via the main street.''
:'''mi kakne lo ka tsuku lo cmana''' — ''I can reach the mountain.''
:'''lo nu mi tsuku pu spaji le za'umei''' — ''My arrival surprised them.''

'''tu''' — ''that over there'' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''u'ecai tu mo''' — ''Oh my, what is that over there?''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA6 (TA)</small></span>

'''tu'a''' — refers to a noun inside an abstraction noun. '''tu'a''' [noun] is equivalent to '''lo''' '''nu''' '''co'e''' [noun]


:'''mi djica tu'a lo plise''' — ''I want an apple. I want to do something with an apple (probably, to eat it).''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LAhE</small></span>

'''tu'e''' ... '''tu'u''' — brackets for grouping sentences
:ends with: tu'u
:'''mi cadzu ka'ai le gerku''' — ''I will walk with the dog.''
:'''je ba tu'e mi ba jukpa lo nanba i ja ca bo mi lumci le kumfa tu'u''' — ''And then I will either cook the bread or clean the room or doth both at the same time.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: TUhE</small></span>

'''tu'o''' — null operand (used in unary mekso operations) <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:Comment: outside math formulae used to indicate that number can't be applied to the noun.
:'''tu'o sluni cu zvati le patxu''' — ''There is a mash of oinons in the pot.''
:Related words: '''zi'o'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA5</small></span>

'''tu'u''' — seldom elidable


:starts with: tu'e<span style='float:right'><small>class: TUhU</small></span>

'''tubnu''' — x1 (entity) is a tube made of x2 (entity) with the hole made of x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: Also sleeves, hoses. For hollow pipes, x3 can be air, water, etc.
:'''lo tubnu''' — tube, '''lo se tubnu''' — material of a tube, '''lo te tubnu''' — content of a tube
:'''lo vi ponjo se sanmi cu tubnu lo rismi lo finpe sovda''' — ''This Japanese meal is a tube of rice with caviar as its filling.''
:Related words: '''kevna''', '''canlu''', '''slanu''', '''kamju'''

'''tugni''' — x1 (entity) agrees with x2 (entity) that x3 (proposition) is true<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''mi tugni do lo nu lo vi purdi cu melbi''' — ''I agree with you that this is a beautiful garden.''
:Related words: '''sarxe''', '''mapti''', '''darlu''', '''natfe''', '''panpi''', '''sarji'''

'''tujli''' — x1 (entity) is a tulip of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tujli''' — tulip
:'''lo tujli bazi se flora''' — ''The tulips will bloom soon.''
:Related words: '''spati'''

'''tumla''' — x1 (entity) is a parcel of land at x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tumla''' — terrain, parcel of land
:'''ti tumla lo drata gugde''' — ''This is a land of another country.''
:Related words: '''vacri''', '''xamsi''', '''tutra''', '''gugde''', '''xamsi'''

'''tunba''' — x1 (entity) is a sibling of x2 (entity) by bond x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: x3 defines parent of x1 and x2

:'''do tunba mi lo ka se mamta gi'e se patfu''' — ''You are my sibling since we are born from the same mother and father.''
:Related words: '''bruna''', '''mensi''', '''tamne'''

'''tunka''' — x1 (entity) is a quantity of copper<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo tunka''' — copper
:'''xu lo tunka cu narju''' — ''Is copper orange?''
:Related words: '''jinme''', '''lastu''', '''ransu'''

'''tunlo''' — x1 (entity) swallows<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''ra pu tunlo''' — ''He made a swallowing movement.''

'''tunta''' — x1 (entity) pokes, stabs, pricks x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

'''tuple''' — x1 (entity) is a leg of x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

'''u'anai''' — loss

'''u'enai''' — ''Pff!'' (commonplace)

'''u'o''' — courage, boldness <small>''[interjection]''</small>

'''u'ocu'i''' — timidity, shyness

'''ubu''' — letter 'U' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>

'''va'e''' — number > verb denoting position on scale <small>''[verb]''</small>


:Comment: x1 (property of nonce place with '''kau''') is at n-th position on scale x2 (property of nonce place with '''kau'''). The number (n) is put in front of '''va'e'''.

'''vecnu''' — x1 (entity) sells goods or service x2 (entity, property of x3) to x3 (entity) for goods or service x4 (entity, property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>

'''xi''' — subscript prefix, attaches a numeral to a pronoun, preposition, place converter or a verb word giving new meanings <small>''[subscript]''</small>


:Comment: '''se''' '''xi''' '''re''' is the same as '''se''', '''se''' '''xi''' '''ci''' is the same as '''te'''. '''se''' '''xi''' '''pa''' just emphasizes the normal order of places as if there wasn't '''se''' '''xi''' pa''' put here..

'''za'a''' — ''I observe'' <small>''[evidential]''</small>

'''ze''' — 7 (digit) [seven] <small>''[digit/number]''</small>


:'''li ze tcika ti''' — ''It's 7 o'clock.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: PA1</small></span>

'''ze'a''' — during some time unspecified or known from context. Adverb: ''for some time'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''mi pu ze'a sipna''' — ''I slept for a while.''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZEhA</small></span>

'''ze'e''' — ''eternally'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''mi ba ze'e prami do''' — ''I will always love you.''
:'''mi ze'e prami do''' — ''I loved, love and will love you.''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZEhA</small></span>

'''ze'ei''' — being put before two words creates a word with the meaning of the word to the left and the grammar of the word to the right


:Comment: binds two arbitrary words together to form a nonce word whose semantics are indicated by the left word and whose grammar is the same as that of the right word. Useful for creating function words without having to allocate experimental cmavo forms.
:'''panpi ze'ei coi''' — ''Peace to you! (as a greeting).''
:Related words: '''zei'''

'''ze'i''' — ''during ...'' (a short time). Adverb: ''for a short time'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''ai mi ze'i sipna''' — ''I'm going to take a nap (to sleep for a short time).''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZEhA</small></span>

'''ze'o''' — ''outwards, beyond ...'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''da tricu ze'o le rirxe''' — ''There is a tree across the river.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: FAhA4</small></span>

'''ze'u''' — ''during a long time''. Adverb: ''for a long time'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''mi pu ze'u sipna ba lo ka citka''' — ''I took a long nap after eating.''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZEhA</small></span>

'''zei''' — makes one single word out of two


:'''loi certu pu pilno lo xy zei kantu''' — ''Experts used X-rays.''
:Related words: '''ze'ei'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZEI</small></span>

'''zekri''' — x1 (event) is a crime to x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zekri''' — crime
:'''xu lo nu catra lo mabru cu zekri do''' — ''Is killing mammals a crime to you?''
:Related words: '''flalu''', '''sfasa''', '''zungi''', '''palci''', '''lijda''', '''pajni''', '''javni''', '''tcaci''', '''marde''', '''pulji''', '''tinbe'''

'''zenba''' — x1 (entity) increases in x2 (property of x1) by amount x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zenba''' — increasing
:'''mi zenba lo ka se cfipu vau lo mutce''' — ''My confusion increased a lot.''
:'''e'o do zenba lo ka masno lo ka tavla i e'o do tavla masno zenba''' — ''Would you please speak more slowly?''
:Related words: '''jdika''', '''zmadu''', '''banro''', '''jmina'''

'''zepti''' — x1 (entity) is 10 to the negative twenty-first of x2 (same type as x1) in x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''xanore selci be lo marji cu zepti lo molro lo ka se canlu''' — ''One zeptomole (zmol) of substance contains 602 particles.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zetro'''

'''zetro''' — x1 (entity) is 10 to the twenty-first of x2 (same type as x1) in x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo djacu po lo braxamsi be lo terdi cu zetro lo litce be li ji'i papivo lo ka se canlu''' — ''The volume of seawater in the Earth's oceans is approximately 1.4 zettalitres (ZL).
''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti'''

'''zgana''' — x1 (entity) observes x2 (entity) using sense x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zgana''' — observer, spectator
:'''mi zgana lo zgike gi'e lo filme''' — ''I'm listening to the music and watching a film.''
:'''mi zgana lo tcini lo ka tirna''' — ''I'm monitoring the situation by listening.''
:'''le ctuca pu jai se zgana fai lo ka bu'u lo barja''' — ''The teacher was spotted in a bar.''
:Related words: '''ga'a''', '''ganse''', '''viska''', '''catlu''', '''tirna''', '''pencu''', '''sumne''', '''kurji''', '''canci''', '''catlu''', '''jarco''', '''lanli''', '''pinka''', '''simlu'''

'''zgike''' — x1 (sound) is music performed by x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zgike''' — music
:'''lo zgike be lo za'u na cladu''' — ''The music of birds isn't loud.''
:Related words: '''damri''', '''dansu''', '''flani''', '''janbe''', '''jgita''', '''pipno''', '''rilti''', '''tabra''', '''tonga''', '''xagri''', '''siclu'''

'''zgipli''' — x1 (entity) plays musicx2 (entity) on a musical instrument x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zgipli''' — musician, '''lo te zgipli''' — musical instrument
:'''do certu lo ka zgipli lo melbi lo flani''' — ''You are a pro in playing beautiful melodies on the flute.''
:Related words: '''zgike''', '''pilno'''

'''zi''' — ''a short time ago'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''mi ba volve bazi lo cacra be li pa''' — ''I will return soon, in an hour.''
:Related words: '''zi''', '''za''', '''zu'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZI</small></span>

'''zi'e''' — ''and'' <small>''[connective for relative clauses]''</small>


:Comment: in Modern Lojban dialects a simple '''je''' is used instead of this word.
:'''le prenu poi pu tavla do zi'e noi blondino cu bruna mi vau uepei''' — ''The man that talked to you and who is blond is my brother, surprised?''
:Related words: '''je''', '''e''', '''gi'e'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZIhE</small></span>

'''zi'evla''' — x1 (text) is a free-form word<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: zi'evla is a type of Lojban verb defined by the form of the word
:'''lo zi'evla''' — zi'evla
:'''zo zigzagi zi'evla''' — ''zigzagi is a zi'evla word.''
:Related words: '''selbrivla''', '''gismu''', '''lujvo''', '''cmavo'''

'''zi'o''' — marks the place as deleted from the place structure thus forming a new verb <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''zi'o traduki zo coi zoi gy. Hello! .gy.''' — ''Hello! is a translation of '''coi'''.''
:'''loi jmive cu se zbasu zi'o lo selci''' — ''Living beings are made from cells.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA7</small></span>

'''zifre''' — x1 (entity) is at liberty or free to do or be x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''mi zifre lo ka zukte lo se nelci be mi''' — ''I am free to do what I like.''
:Related words: '''pinfu''', '''rinju''', '''bilga''', '''permite''', '''kakne''', '''frili'''

'''zigzagi''' — x1 (entity) is a line with the shape of a zigzag<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zigzagi''' — zigzag
:'''lo pluta be lo cmana pu zigzagi''' — ''The route to the mountain zigzagged.''
:Related words: '''boxna''', '''linji'''

'''zildukse''' — x1 (entity) is in excess, is too much for x2 (property of x1) to take place (event)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zildukse''' — excess
:'''lo nu mi tatpi cu zildukse lo nu mi sidju do''' — ''I'm too tired to help you.''
:Related words: '''bancu''', '''banzu''', '''ricfu''', '''zmadu'''

'''zinki''' — x1 (entity) is a quantity of zinc<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zinki''' — zinc
:'''lo cidja cu vasru lo zinki''' — ''The food contains zinc.''
:Related words: '''jinme'''

'''zirpu''' — x1 (entity) is purple<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zirpu''' — purple
:'''lo taxfu cu zirpu''' — ''The dress is purple.''
:Related words: '''skari''', '''blabi''', '''xekri''', '''kandi''', '''carmi''', '''nukni''', '''blanu''', '''xunre'''

'''zivle''' — x1 (entity) invests resources x2 (entity) into x3 (entity, property of x1) expecting profit x4 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zivle''' — investor, '''lo se zivle''' — invested, '''lo ve zivle''' — expected profit of an investment
:'''ra pu zivle lo jdini lo ka sidju lo cnino sanga''' — ''He invested money in a new singer.''
:'''ai mi zivle lo nejni lo ka prami do vau lo nu do prami mi''' — ''I take a chance on loving you so that you will love me.''
:Related words: '''prali''', '''canja''', '''jbera''', '''dejni''', '''ponse'''

'''zmadu''' — x1 (entity) exceeds or is more than x2 (entity) in x3 (property of x1 and x2 with '''kau''') by amount x4 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zmadu''' — more, '''lo se zmadu''' — less
:'''ra zmadu mi lo ka tilju vau lo ki'ogra be li pano''' — ''He weighs ten more kilograms than me.''
:Related words: '''mau''', '''mleca''', '''zenba''', '''jmina''', '''bancu''', '''dukse''', '''traji'''

'''zmiku''' — x1 (entity) is automatic in function x2 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zmiku''' — robot, automatic, '''lo se zmiku''' — function of a robot
:'''lo vorme ci zmiku lo ka co'a kalri''' — ''The door opens automatically.''
:Related words: '''macnu'''

'''zo''' — verb > noun that is a quote


:Comment: '''zo''' and one single Lojban word after it make a quotation, it works as a noun. To quote compound particles, compound verbs and phrases use '''lu''' ...'''li'u'''. To quote arbitrary sequences of words use '''lo'u''' ... '''le'u'''..
:'''zo gleki cmene mi''' — ''Gleki is my name.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZO</small></span>

'''zo'e''' — noun unspecified or known from context <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''zo'e carvi''' — ''It's raining.''
:'''la eduard pu cusku zo'e ne le pa gerku''' — ''Eduard said something about the dog.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA7</small></span>

'''zo'ei''' — ''something about ...'', ''something associated with ...''


:Comment: equivalent to '''zo'e''' '''pe'''.
:ends with: lu'u
:'''mi pu na djuno zo'ei le nabmi''' — ''I didn't know of the problem.''
:Related words: '''tu'a'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: LAhE</small></span>

'''zo'i''' — ''on the same side as ...'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''mi sanli bu'u lo klaji zo'i le muzga''' — ''I'm standing on the street on the same side as the museum.''
:'''mi zutse lo lalxu korbi zo'i le laldo cindu''' — ''I'm sitting by the river on the same side as the old oak.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: FAhA4</small></span>

'''zo'o''' — ''Kidding...'' (humorously) <small>''[interjection modifier]''</small>

'''zo'ocu'i''' — without paying attention to seriousness or humor

'''zo'onai''' — ''seriously''
:'''zo'opei''' — ''Are you kidding?''
:'''e'u zo'o renro la kevin lo vi kevna''' — ''Let's throw Kevin into this hole (kidding ...) I might be able to jump from the hill.''
:'''mi kakne lo ka plipe fi lo ve'i cmana vau zo'ocu'i i zo'onai do fanza''' — ''Seriously, you are annoying.''
:Related words: '''xajmi''', '''junri'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI5</small></span>

'''zo'oi''' — foreign word > noun that is a quote


:Comment: '''zo'oi''' and one single word after it make a quotation, it works as a noun. The word after '''zo'oi''': might be from any language and written in any script, it is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides, it can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written. To quote several words or one word with pauses inside use '''zoi'''.
:'''zo'oi again se traduki fi lu za'ure'u li'u''' — ''Again is translated as '''za'u re'u'''.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZOhOI</small></span>

'''zo'u''' — separates topic and comment


:'''lo danlu zo'u mi nelci lo mlatu''' — ''As for animals, I like cats.''
:'''vo da poi gerku vau re de poi prenu zo'u da batci de''' — ''There are four '''da''' (that are dogs) and there are two '''de''' (that are men) such that each dog ('''da''') bites the two men ('''de''').''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZOhU</small></span>

'''zoi''' — foreign text > noun that is a quote


:Comment: quotes a text that can be not Lojbanic. The quotation is to be wrapped with pauses from both sides and with an additional Lojbanic word around them from both sides. Usually the separating Lojbanic word is the first letter of the language in the quotation..
:'''lu coi ro do li'u se traduki fi zoi gy. Hello, everyone! .gy. noi glico''' — '''''coi ro do''' is translated to English as Hello, everyone!''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZOI</small></span>

'''zu''' — ''a long time ago'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''la alis pu cliva zu lo nanca be li pano''' — ''Alice left ten years ago (a long time).''
:Related words: '''zi''', '''za''', '''zu'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: ZI</small></span>

'''zu'a''' — ''leftwards'', ''to the left of ...'' <small>''[preposition]''</small>


:'''ko catlu lo pa karce pe zu'a do''' — ''Look at a car to the left of you.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: FAhA2</small></span>

'''zu'e''' — ''via a free will'', ''with an actor ...'' <small>''[preposition from {zukte}]''</small>


:Comment: actor case tag. x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo zukte''', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo se zukte'''.
:'''zu'enai je fa mi viska lo dinju''' — ''A building caught my eye.''
:'''zu'e je fa mi tirna lo zgike''' — ''I listened to the music.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: BAI</small></span>

'''zu'i''' — noun typical for this place <small>''[pronoun]''</small>


:'''mi pu penmi zu'i bu'u zu'i''' — ''I met the usual people at the usual place.''<span style='float:right'><small>class: KOhA7</small></span>

'''zu'u''' — ''on the one hand'' <small>''[discursive]''</small>

'''zu'unai''' — ''on the other hand''
:'''zu'u le jufra cu satci lo ka se smuni''' — ''On the one hand, the sentence is exact in meaning.''
:'''zu'unai du'eva'e clani''' — ''On the other hand it is too long.''
:Related words: '''karbi''', '''frica''', '''dukti'''<span style='float:right'><small>class: UI3</small></span>

'''zukte''' — x1 (entity) takes action x2 (property of x1) for purpose x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zukte''' — actor, '''lo se zukte''' — taken action, '''lo te zukte''' — purpose of action
:'''i mi zukte lo me mi moi tu'a lo me mi moi''' — ''I'm doing my own work for myself.''
:'''xu do ca'o zukte lo cipra''' — ''Are you performing a test?''
:'''mi zukte lo ka darxi le nakni''' — ''I intentionally hit him.''
:'''mi ba zukte roda lonu do nelci mi''' — ''I would do everything so that you like me.''
:Related words: '''zu'e''', '''bapli''', '''gunka''', '''jalge''', '''krinu''', '''mukti''', '''rinka''', '''snuti''', '''gasnu''', '''fasnu''', '''minji''', '''prenu''', '''ciksi''', '''jibri''', '''pilno''', '''pluta''', '''tadji''', '''tutci'''

'''zumri''' — x1 (entity) is some corn or maize of species x2 (species)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zumri''' — maize
:'''mi sombo lo samcu je lo zumri''' — ''I plant yams and maize.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''

'''zungi''' — x1 (entity) feels guilty about x2 (event, property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''mi zungi lo ka pu cusku lo jitfa''' — ''I feel guilty about having told a lie.''
:Related words: '''u'u''', '''cinmo''', '''xenru''', '''zekri'''

'''zunle''' — x1 (entity) is to the left of x2 (entity) in frame of reference x3 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''lo zunle''' — left (in direction)
:'''lo dinju cu zunle lo rokci ti''' — ''The house is to the left of the rock if viewed from here.''
:Related words: '''zu'a''', '''pritu''', '''mlana''', '''crane''', '''trixe''', '''farna'''

'''zunti''' — x1 (entity) interferes with or disrupts x2 (entity) due to x3 (property of x1)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>, '''lo se zunti''' — hindered, disrupted
:'''lo gerku cu zunti lo nu mi lumci lo kumfa vau lo ka plipe''' — ''The dog leaping hinders me from cleaning the room.''
:Related words: '''fanta''', '''dicra''', '''fliba''', '''fanza''', '''raktu''', '''klina''', '''bandu''', '''cfipu''', '''ganlo'''

'''zutse''' — x1 (entity) sits on x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:'''e'a do zutse lo stizu''' — ''You may sit down on the chair.''
:Related words: '''stizu''', '''cpana''', '''vreta'''

'''zvati''' — x1 (entity) is present at x2 (entity)<span style='float:right'><small>[verb]</small></span>
:Comment: '''stuzi''' is for a stable/inherent location
:'''lo sivni kumfa cu zvati ma''' — ''Where is the toilet?''
:'''mi pu zvati lo nu penmi''' — ''I was at the meeting.''
:Related words: '''stuzi''', '''jbini''', '''nenri''', '''se''' '''vasru''', '''cpana''', '''diklo''', '''jibni''', '''cabna''', '''lamji''', '''tcini''', '''xabju''', '''jmive''', '''jundi''', '''vitke'''

'''zy''' — letter 'Z' <small>''[pronoun]''</small>

<span style='float:right'><small>class: BY2</small></span>
